name: Bulbasaur
description_en: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this POKéMON.
description_es: Una rara semilla le fue plantada en el lomo al nacer. La planta brota y crece con este Pokémon.

name: Ivysaur
description_en: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.
description_es: Este Pokémon tiene un bulbo en el lomo. Dicen que, al absorber nutrientes, el bulbo se transforma en una flor grande.

name: Venusaur
description_en: The plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.
description_es: Llena su cuerpo de energía con los rayos solares que captan los anchos pétalos de su flor.

name: Charmander
description_en: Obviously prefers hot places. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.
description_es: La llama de su cola indica la fuerza vital de Charmander. Será brillante si está sano.

name: Charmeleon
description_en: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the temperature to unbearably high levels.
description_es: Suele usar la cola para derribar a su rival. Cuando lo tira, se vale de sus afiladas garras para acabar con él.

name: Charizard
description_en: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to cause forest fires unintentionally.
description_es: Cuando lanza una descarga de fuego supercaliente, la roja llama de su cola brilla más intensamente.

name: Squirtle
description_en: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. Powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.
description_es: Se protege con su caparazón y luego contraataca lanzando agua a presión cuando tiene oportunidad.

name: Wartortle
description_en: Often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. For swimming fast, it moves its ears to maintain balance.
description_es: Si es golpeado, esconderá su cabeza. Aun así, su cola puede seguir golpeando.

name: Blastoise
description_en: A brutal POKéMON with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high speed tackles.
description_es: Para acabar con su enemigo, lo aplasta con el peso de su cuerpo. En momentos de apuro, se esconde en el caparazón.

name: Caterpie
description_en: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.
description_es: Para protegerse despide un hedor horrible de sus antenas, con el que repele a sus enemigos.

name: Metapod
description_en: This POKéMON is vulnerable to attack while its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.
description_es: Su frágil cuerpo está recubierto de una coraza dura como el acero. Permanece quieto en su desarrollo.

name: Butterfree
description_en: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.
description_es: Adora el néctar de las flores. Puede localizar hasta las más pequeñas cantidades de polen.

name: Weedle
description_en: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp venomous stinger on its head.
description_es: Suele habitar bosques y praderas. Tiene un afilado y venenoso aguijón de unos 5 cm encima de la cabeza.

name: Kakuna
description_en: Almost incapable of moving, this POKéMON can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.
description_es: Casi incapaz de moverse, este Pokémon solo puede endurecer su caparazón para protegerse.

name: Beedrill
description_en: Flies at high speed and attacks using its large venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.
description_es: Tiene 3 aguijones venenosos en sus patas y cola. Suelen pinchar a sus enemigos repetidas veces.

name: Pidgey
description_en: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.
description_es: Muy común en bosques y selvas. Aletea al nivel del suelo para levantar la gravilla.

name: Pidgeotto
description_en: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this POKéMON will fiercely peck at any intruder.
description_es: Tiene unas garras desarrolladas. Puede atrapar un Exeggcute y transportarlo desde una distancia de casi 100 km.

name: Pidgeot
description_en: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as MAGIKARP.
description_es: Cuando caza, vuela muy deprisa a ras del agua y sorprende a inocentes presas como Magikarp.

name: Rattata
description_en: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.
description_es: Vive allí donde haya comida disponible. Busca todo el día, sin descanso, algo comestible.

name: Raticate
description_en: It uses its whis­ kers to maintain its balance. It apparently slows down if they are cut off.
description_es: Lima sus colmillos royendo objetos duros. Con ellos puede destruir incluso paredes de hormigón.

name: Spearow
description_en: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speed to stay airborne.
description_es: Muy protector de su territorio, mueve sus cortas alas sin descanso para lanzarse a toda velocidad.

name: Fearow
description_en: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.
description_es: Con sus enormes y magníficas alas, puede seguir volando sin tener que aterrizar para descansar.

name: Ekans
description_en: Moves silently and stealthily. Eats the eggs of birds, such as PIDGEY and SPEAROW, whole.
description_es: Cuanto más viejo, más crece este Pokémon. Por la noche, descansa en las ramas de los árboles.

name: Arbok
description_en: It is rumored that the ferocious warning markings on its belly differ from area to area.
description_es: El dibujo que tiene en la panza aterroriza. Los rivales más débiles salen huyendo al verlo.

name: Pikachu
description_en: When several of these POKéMON gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.
description_es: Levanta su cola para vigilar los alrededores. A veces, puede ser alcanzado por un rayo en esa pose.

name: Raichu
description_en: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high voltage power.
description_es: Cuando se carga de electricidad, sus músculos se tensan y se vuelve más agresivo de lo normal.

name: Sandshrew
description_en: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.
description_es: Este Pokémon permanece bajo tierra. Si se siente amenazado, se enrosca para defenderse.

name: Sandslash
description_en: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.
description_es: Si cava a gran velocidad, puede que se le caigan las garras y púas. Vuelven a crecerle en un día.

name: Nidoran-f
description_en: Although small, its venomous barbs render this POKéMON dangerous. The female has smaller horns.
description_es: Aunque pequeñas, sus venenosas púas son muy peligrosas. Tienen un cuerno más pequeño que los machos.

name: Nidorina
description_en: The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.
description_es: Tiene un carácter afable. Emite ondas ultrasónicas para confundir al enemigo.

name: Nidoqueen
description_en: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.
description_es: Usa su cuerpo duro y escamoso para sellar la entrada a su madriguera y protegerse de los depredadores.

name: Nidoran-m
description_en: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger its horns, the more powerful its secreted venom.
description_es: Saca las orejas por encima de la hierba para explorar el territorio. Le protege su cuerno venenoso.

name: Nidorino
description_en: An aggressive POKéMON that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.
description_es: Levanta sus grandes orejas para vigilar. Si detecta algo, atacará de inmediato.

name: Nidoking
description_en: It uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break the prey's bones.
description_es: Es fácil reconocerlo por tener una dura piel y un gran cuerno lleno de peligrosísimo veneno.

name: Clefairy
description_en: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.
description_es: Se dice que la felicidad llegará a quien vea a un grupo de Clefairy bailando a la luz de la luna llena.

name: Clefable
description_en: A timid fairy POKéMON that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.
description_es: Su oído es tan agudo que puede oír una aguja caer a 1 km. Vive en montañas solitarias.

name: Vulpix
description_en: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.
description_es: Cuando nace solo tiene una cola, pero a medida que crece, esta se va dividiendo desde la punta.

name: Ninetales
description_en: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1000-year curse.
description_es: Tiene nueve colas y un pelaje de color dorado. Dicen que este Pokémon llega a vivir 1000 años.

name: Jigglypuff
description_en: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.
description_es: Cautiva con la mirada a su enemigo y hace que se quede profundamente dormido mientras entona una dulce melodía.

name: Wigglytuff
description_en: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.
description_es: Su piel es tan suave que si dos de ellos se acurrucan juntos, no querrán separarse nunca.

name: Zubat
description_en: Forms colonies in perpetually dark places. Uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.
description_es: Aunque carezca de ojos, puede detectar obstáculos con las ondas ultrasónicas que emite su boca.

name: Golbat
description_en: Once it strikes, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.
description_es: Cuando ataque, seguirá chupando energía de su víctima, aunque pese tanto que ya no pueda volar.

name: Oddish
description_en: During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.
description_es: Durante el día, se agazapa en el frío subsuelo huyendo del sol. La luz de la luna le hace crecer mucho.

name: Gloom
description_en: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.
description_es: ¡Huele bastante mal! De todas formas, una de cada mil personas aprecian su fétido olor.

name: Vileplume
description_en: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.
description_es: Cuanto mayores son sus pétalos, más tóxico es su polen. Le pesa la cabeza y le cuesta mantenerla erguida.

name: Paras
description_en: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by draw­ ing nutrients from the bug host.
description_es: Lleva en el lomo dos setas parásitas llamadas tochukaso, que crecen con él.

name: Parasect
description_en: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.
description_es: Parasect está dominado por una seta parásita mayor que él. Dispersa esporas venenosas.

name: Venonat
description_en: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.
description_es: Sus grandes ojos son en realidad grupos de ojos diminutos. Por la noche se siente atraído por la luz.

name: Venomoth
description_en: The dust-like scales covering its wings are color coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.
description_es: Lanza unas escamas que paralizan a cualquiera. Quien las toque, no podrá ni ponerse de pie.

name: Diglett
description_en: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.
description_es: Vive un metro por debajo del suelo, donde se alimenta de raíces. También aparece en la superficie.

name: Dugtrio
description_en: A team of DIGLETT triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.
description_es: En combate, cava la tierra, se esconde y sale de repente para golpear a su rival. Nunca se sabe por dónde puede aparecer.

name: Meowth
description_en: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.
description_es: Es de naturaleza nocturna. Le atraen los objetos brillantes.

name: Persian
description_en: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.
description_es: Aunque es muy admirado por el pelo, es difícil de entrenar como mascota, porque es un poco travieso.

name: Psyduck
description_en: While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily POKéMON will use psychokinetic powers.
description_es: Padece continuamente dolores de cabeza. Cuando son muy fuertes, empieza a usar misteriosos poderes.

name: Golduck
description_en: Often seen swim­ ming elegantly by lake shores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster, Kappa.
description_es: Aparece en ríos al anochecer. Puede usar poderes telequinéticos si su frente brilla misteriosamente.

name: Mankey
description_en: Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment then thrashing away the next instant.
description_es: Es peligroso acercarse si se enfada sin razón aparente, ya que no distingue entre amigos y enemigos.

name: Primeape
description_en: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until it is caught.
description_es: Solo se calma cuando nadie está cerca. Llegar a ver ese momento es realmente difícil.

name: Growlithe
description_en: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.
description_es: Es muy agradable y leal. Para ahuyentar al enemigo, se pone a ladrar y a dar bocados.

name: Arcanine
description_en: A POKéMON that has been admired since the past for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.
description_es: Un Pokémon muy admirado desde la antigüedad por su belleza. Corre ágilmente como si tuviera alas.

name: Poliwag
description_en: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming than trying to stand.
description_es: Tiene una piel extraordinaria, fina y húmeda, que deja entrever las vísceras que tiene dispuestas en espiral.

name: Poliwhirl
description_en: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.
description_es: Capaz de vivir dentro o fuera del agua. Fuera del agua suda para mantener baboso su cuerpo.

name: Poliwrath
description_en: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breast stroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.
description_es: Tiene músculos muy desarrollados. Es capaz de nadar en el océano sin descanso.

name: Abra
description_en: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and TELEPORT to safety.
description_es: Duerme 18 horas al día y mientras lo hace es capaz de usar una serie de poderes extrasensoriales.

name: Kadabra
description_en: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close by.
description_es: Cuando utiliza su poder psíquico, emite poderosas ondas alfa que pueden destruir dispositivos.

name: Alakazam
description_en: Its brain can out­ perform a super­ computer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5,000.
description_es: Sus neuronas se multiplican continuamente durante su vida. Por eso, siempre lo recuerda todo.

name: Machop
description_en: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.
description_es: Levanta un Graveler para mantener sus músculos en forma. Domina todas las artes marciales.

name: Machoke
description_en: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power save belt to be able to regulate its motions.
description_es: Su musculoso cuerpo es tan fuerte que usa un cinto antifuerza para controlar sus movimientos.

name: Machamp
description_en: Using its heavy muscles, it throws powerful punches that can send the victim clear over the horizon.
description_es: Tiene cuatro brazos tan bien desarrollados que puede dar una serie de 1000 puñetazos en cuestión de dos segundos.

name: Bellsprout
description_en: A carnivorous POKéMON that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.
description_es: Aunque su cuerpo es extremadamente delgado, es muy rápido a la hora de capturar sus presas.

name: Weepinbell
description_en: It spits out POISONPOWDER to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of ACID.
description_es: Las hojas que tiene actúan como cuchillas en combate. Otra de sus armas es el corrosivo fluido que expulsa.

name: Victreebel
description_en: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.
description_es: Dicen que vive en grandes colonias en el interior de las junglas, aunque nadie ha podido verificarlo.

name: Tentacool
description_en: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by its stinging acid.
description_es: Su cuerpo se compone casi en exclusiva de agua. Lanza extraños rayos con sus ojos cristalinos.

name: Tentacruel
description_en: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.
description_es: Cuando caza, extiende los cortos tentáculos que tiene para atrapar e inmovilizar a su presa.

name: Geodude
description_en: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.
description_es: Aparecen en llanos y montañas. Como parecen rocas, la gente se tropieza con ellos o los pisa.

name: Graveler
description_en: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.
description_es: De naturaleza descuidada y libre, no le importa dañarse cuando baja rodando montañas.

name: Golem
description_en: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.
description_es: Se lanza montaña abajo y deja un surco desde la cima hasta el pie. Es mejor mantenerse alejado.

name: Ponyta
description_en: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything completely flat in little time.
description_es: Cuando nace, apenas puede tenerse en pie. Pero va fortaleciendo las patas en cuanto empieza a galopar.

name: Rapidash
description_en: Very competitive, this POKéMON will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.
description_es: Muy competitivo, este Pokémon perseguirá a todo lo que se mueva rápido e intentará salir airoso.

name: Slowpoke
description_en: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes 5 seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.
description_es: Está siempre en su mundo, pero nadie sabe en qué piensa. Suele pescar con la cola.

name: Slowbro
description_en: The SHELLDER that is latched onto SLOWPOKE's tail is said to feed on the host's left over scraps.
description_es: Tiene una cola tan apetecible, que el Shellder que va enganchado a ella no se soltará por nada del mundo.

name: Magnemite
description_en: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses THUNDER WAVE and similar moves.
description_es: Las unidades a los lados de su cuerpo generan energía antigravitatoria para mantenerlo en el aire.

name: Magneton
description_en: Formed by several MAGNEMITEs linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.
description_es: Lo constituye un grupo de Magnemite. Descarga potentes ondas magnéticas de alto voltaje.

name: Farfetchd
description_en: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. It is used much like a metal sword.
description_es: El puerro que lleva es su mejor arma. Suele usarlo como espada para cortar cosas.

name: Doduo
description_en: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.
description_es: Este Pokémon de dos cabezas es el resultado de una mutación. Cuando corre, puede alcanzar casi 100 km por hora.

name: Dodrio
description_en: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake.
description_es: Más vale no perder de vista ninguna de las tres cabezas. De lo contrario, el número de picotazos será enorme.

name: Seel
description_en: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.
description_es: Este Pokémon vive en icebergs. Nada en el mar y usa el cuerno de su cabeza para romper el hielo.

name: Dewgong
description_en: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.
description_es: Está recubierto de un luminoso pelaje blanco. Este Pokémon aumenta su actividad cuando bajan las temperaturas.

name: Grimer
description_en: Appears in filthy areas. Thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.
description_es: Nace de lodo alterado al filtrarse en el agua los rayos X reflejados por la Luna. Se alimenta de sustancias desagradables.

name: Muk
description_en: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.
description_es: Les encanta reunirse en zonas apestosas donde se acumula el lodo, haciendo su olor más insoportable.

name: Shellder
description_en: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.
description_es: La concha lo protege de cualquier tipo de ataque. Solo es vulnerable cuando se abre.

name: Cloyster
description_en: When attacked, it launches its horns in quick volleys. Its innards have never been seen.
description_es: A los Cloyster que viven en las fuertes corrientes marinas les crecen largas y afiladas púas en la concha.

name: Gastly
description_en: Almost invisible, this gaseous POKéMON cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.
description_es: Su etéreo cuerpo está hecho de gas. Puede envolver a un oponente de cualquier tamaño hasta ahogarlo.

name: Haunter
description_en: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from an­ other dimension.
description_es: Cuando tienes la sensación de que te están observando, seguro que es porque Haunter está cerca.

name: Gengar
description_en: Under a full moon, this POKéMON likes to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.
description_es: Se esconde entre las sombras. Se dice que donde Gengar acecha, la temperatura baja 5 °C.

name: Onix
description_en: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, but colored black.
description_es: Cava a gran velocidad en busca de comida. Los túneles que deja son usados por los Diglett.

name: Drowzee
description_en: Puts enemies to sleep then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.
description_es: Adormece a sus enemigos y se come sus sueños. A veces se pone enfermo si come pesadillas.

name: Hypno
description_en: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of PSI moves such as HYPNOSIS and CONFUSION.
description_es: Lleva un péndulo en la mano. Una vez, hizo desaparecer a un niño al que había hipnotizado.

name: Krabby
description_en: Its pincers are not only powerful weapons, they are used for balance when walking sideways.
description_es: Ante el peligro, se camufla con las burbujas que desprende su boca, para parecer más grande.

name: Kingler
description_en: The large pincer has 10000 hp of crushing power. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.
description_es: La pinza tan grande que tiene posee una fuerza de 10 000 caballos de potencia. Pero, por su gran tamaño, cuesta moverla.

name: Voltorb
description_en: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a POKé BALL, they have zapped many people.
description_es: Fue descubierto cuando se crearon las Poké Balls. Se dice que tiene algo que ver con ellas.

name: Electrode
description_en: It stores electric energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.
description_es: Explotan a la mínima. Por eso se les tiene mucho miedo. Estos Pokémon reciben el mote de Bomba Ball.

name: Exeggcute
description_en: Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.
description_es: Estos seis huevos se comunican por telepatía. Si se separan, se pueden reunir rápidamente.

name: Exeggutor
description_en: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an EXEGGCUTE.
description_es: Sus tres cabezas piensan de forma independiente. Sin embargo, son amigas y no suelen discutir nunca.

name: Cubone
description_en: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this POKéMON's real face.
description_es: Lleva puesto el cráneo de su madre. Cuando se siente solo se pone a gritar muy fuerte.

name: Marowak
description_en: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.
description_es: Es pequeño y siempre ha sido muy débil. Cuando empezó a usar huesos, se volvió más violento.

name: Hitmonlee
description_en: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.
description_es: Encoge y estira las patas a su antojo. Cuando las estira, es capaz de propinar una buena patada al enemigo.

name: Hitmonchan
description_en: While apparently doing nothing, it fires punches in lightning fast volleys that are impossible to see.
description_es: Los potentes golpes de sus brazos pueden pulverizar el hormigón. Descansa tras luchar tres minutos.

name: Lickitung
description_en: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon's. It leaves a tingling sensation when it licks enemies.
description_es: Su larga lengua, recubierta de saliva pegajosa, se pega a todo, por lo que es muy útil.

name: Koffing
description_en: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.
description_es: Tiene forma de globo y es muy ligero. Está compuesto por gases tóxicos y apesta.

name: Weezing
description_en: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, 2 KOFFINGs can fuse into a WEEZING over many years.
description_es: Si uno de los gemelos Koffing se infla, el otro se desinfla. Mezclan constantemente sus venenosos gases.

name: Rhyhorn
description_en: Its massive bones are 1000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.
description_es: Es muy fuerte, pero no especialmente listo. Es capaz de derribar rascacielos usando Placaje varias veces.

name: Rhydon
description_en: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees.
description_es: La piel le sirve de escudo protector. Puede vivir en lava líquida a 2000 °C de temperatura.

name: Chansey
description_en: A rare and elusive POKéMON that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to get it.
description_es: Se dice que reparte felicidad. Se caracteriza por su compasión y reparte sus huevos entre la gente herida.

name: Tangela
description_en: The whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to sea­ weed. Its vines shake as it walks.
description_es: Se camufla con la multitud de lianas que envuelven su cuerpo y que no dejan de crecer a lo largo de toda su vida.

name: Kangaskhan
description_en: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is 3 years old.
description_es: Lleva a su cría en la bolsa de su panza. Solo deja que su cría salga a jugar cuando no siente peligro.

name: Horsea
description_en: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.
description_es: Es famoso por derribar a bichos voladores lanzando tinta desde la superficie del agua.

name: Seadra
description_en: Capable of swim­ ming backwards by rapidly flapping its wing-like pectoral fins and stout tail.
description_es: Las afiladas púas que le recubren el cuerpo se le erizan y pueden causar el debilitamiento con solo tocarlo.

name: Goldeen
description_en: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname of the Water Queen.
description_es: Nada a una velocidad de cinco nudos. Si siente peligro, golpea con su afilado cuerno.

name: Seaking
description_en: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming power­ fully up rivers and creeks.
description_es: En otoño, cuando se reproducen, se les puede ver nadando con energía por ríos y arroyos.

name: Staryu
description_en: An enigmatic POKéMON that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.
description_es: Aunque sus brazos se rompan podrán regenerarse, siempre y cuando su núcleo siga intacto.

name: Starmie
description_en: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.
description_es: Su núcleo central brilla con los colores del arcoíris. Para algunos tiene el valor de una gema.

name: Mr-mime
description_en: If interrupted while it is miming, it will slap around the offender with its broad hands.
description_es: Para repeler ataques, solidifica el aire y crea muros invisibles con emanaciones de sus dedos.

name: Scyther
description_en: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one.
description_es: Destroza a su presa con las guadañas que tiene. No es común que use las alas para volar.

name: Jynx
description_en: It seductively wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.
description_es: Camina moviendo las caderas de forma llamativa. Puede hacer que la gente baile a su ritmo.

name: Electabuzz
description_en: Normally found near power plants, they can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.
description_es: Por la superficie de su piel corre la electricidad. En la oscuridad, su cuerpo se torna blanquecino.

name: Magmar
description_en: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.
description_es: A este Pokémon se lo encontraron cerca de un volcán. Esta criatura ígnea tiene una temperatura corporal de unos 1200 °C.

name: Pinsir
description_en: If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing it around and toss it hard.
description_es: Atrapa presas con sus pinzas hasta que las parte en dos. Lanza lejos lo que no puede quebrar.

name: Tauros
description_en: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.
description_es: Después de animarse a luchar fustigándose con sus tres colas, carga a toda velocidad.

name: Magikarp
description_en: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.
description_es: No es precisamente rápido ni fuerte. Es el Pokémon más debilucho y simplón de todos los que hay.

name: Gyarados
description_en: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.
description_es: En la literatura antigua se dice que un Gyarados rebosante de violencia arrasó un poblado.

name: Lapras
description_en: A POKéMON that has been over­ hunted almost to extinction. It can ferry people across the water.
description_es: Son buenos de corazón. Muchos fueron capturados por ser tan pacíficos. Ahora hay muchos menos.

name: Ditto
description_en: Capable of copying an enemy's genetic code to instantly transform itself into a duplicate of the enemy.
description_es: Puede alterar por completo su estructura celular para emular cualquier objeto que vea.

name: Eevee
description_en: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element STONEs.
description_es: Un extraño Pokémon que se adapta a los entornos más hostiles gracias a sus diferentes evoluciones.

name: Vaporeon
description_en: Lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.
description_es: Prefiere las bellas costas. Con células parecidas al agua, podría fundirse en la misma.

name: Jolteon
description_en: It accumulates negative ions in the atmosphere to blast out 10000- volt lightning bolts.
description_es: Todos los pelos de su cuerpo se ponen de punta si empieza a cargarse de electricidad.

name: Flareon
description_en: When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature could soar to over 1600 degrees.
description_es: Almacena llamas en su cuerpo, que alcanza una temperatura de 900 °C antes de un combate.

name: Porygon
description_en: A POKéMON that consists entirely of programming code. Capable of moving freely in cyberspace.
description_es: Pokémon creado por el hombre tras muchas investigaciones. Sus habilidades son básicas.

name: Omanyte
description_en: Although long extinct, in rare cases, it can be genetically resurrected from fossils.
description_es: Pokémon prehistórico que vivió en el océano primordial. Para nadar se valía de sus 10 tentáculos.

name: Omastar
description_en: A prehistoric POKéMON that died out when its heavy shell made it impossible to catch prey.
description_es: Tiene los tentáculos tan desarrollados que le sirven de manos y pies. Con ellos atrapa a su presa y le da un bocado.

name: Kabuto
description_en: A POKéMON that was resurrected from a fossil found in what was once the ocean floor eons ago.
description_es: Se cree que habitó las playas hace 300 millones de años. Se protege con una dura concha.

name: Kabutops
description_en: Its sleek shape is perfect for swim­ ming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids.
description_es: Repliega sus extremidades en el agua para hacerse más compacto, y mueve su concha para nadar rápido.

name: Aerodactyl
description_en: A ferocious, pre­ historic POKéMON that goes for the enemy's throat with its serrated saw-like fangs.
description_es: Se regeneró a partir de material genético de un dinosaurio encontrado en ámbar. Cuando vuela emite escandalosos alaridos.

name: Snorlax
description_en: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.
description_es: No se encuentra satisfecho hasta que no se come 400 kg de comida cada día. Cuando acaba de comer, se queda dormido.

name: Articuno
description_en: A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.
description_es: Legendario Pokémon pájaro capaz de generar ventiscas congelando la humedad del aire.

name: Zapdos
description_en: A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.
description_es: Es un legendario pájaro Pokémon. Dicen que aparece entre las nubes lanzando enormes rayos brillantes.

name: Moltres
description_en: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.
description_es: Es más conocido como el legendario pájaro de fuego. Con cada aleteo crea brillantes llamas.

name: Dratini
description_en: Long considered a mythical POKéMON until recently when a small colony was found living underwater.
description_es: Se le llama el Pokémon Espejismo porque son muy pocos los que lo han visto. Se encontró su muda.

name: Dragonair
description_en: A mystical POKéMON that exudes a gentle aura. Has the ability to change climate conditions.
description_es: Sus cristalinos orbes parecen darle al Pokémon el poder de controlar el clima libremente.

name: Dragonite
description_en: An extremely rarely seen marine POKéMON. Its intelligence is said to match that of humans.
description_es: A pesar del tamaño que tiene y de lo pesado que es, puede volar. Es capaz de dar la vuelta al mundo en solo 16 horas.

name: Mewtwo
description_en: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene splicing and DNA engineering experiments.
description_es: Fue creado por un científico tras años de horribles experimentos de ingeniería genética.

name: Mew
description_en: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.
description_es: Varios científicos lo consideran el antecesor de los Pokémon porque usa todo tipo de movimientos.

name: Chikorita
description_en: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up the sun's rays.
description_es: Un dulce aroma se desprende de la hoja de su cabeza. Es dócil y le encanta absorber los rayos de sol.

name: Bayleef
description_en: The scent of spices comes from around its neck. Somehow, sniffing it makes you want to fight.
description_es: Emana un aroma picante de su cuello. El aroma actúa como estimulante para recuperar salud.

name: Meganium
description_en: The aroma that rises from its petals contains a substance that calms aggressive feelings.
description_es: El olor que desprenden sus pétalos contiene una sustancia que calma el instinto agresivo.

name: Cyndaquil
description_en: It is timid, and always curls it­ self up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.
description_es: Es tímido y siempre se enrosca como una pelota. Si es atacado, enciende su lomo para protegerse.

name: Quilava
description_en: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.
description_es: Antes de empezar a luchar, se gira ante su rival para alardear del alcance y la fuerza de sus llamas.

name: Typhlosion
description_en: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.
description_es: Si su furia crece, se calienta tanto que cualquier cosa que toque se prenderá al instante.

name: Totodile
description_en: Its well-developed jaws are powerful and capable of crushing anything. Even its trainer must be careful.
description_es: Es pequeño pero violento. No dudará en morder cualquier cosa que se mueva cerca.

name: Croconaw
description_en: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.
description_es: Si pierde un colmillo, le crecerá otro en su lugar. Siempre tiene 48 colmillos en su boca.

name: Feraligatr
description_en: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.
description_es: Se suele mover lento, pero alcanza velocidades de vértigo al atacar y morder a sus enemigos.

name: Sentret
description_en: A very cautious POKéMON, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.
description_es: Cuando hace de centinela, avisa del peligro a los demás, chillando y dando golpes al suelo con la cola.

name: Furret
description_en: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other POKéMON to enter.
description_es: Acurruca a sus crías para que duerman. Acorrala a los enemigos con su enorme velocidad.

name: Hoothoot
description_en: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.
description_es: Su percepción del tiempo es exacta. Ocurra lo que ocurra, lleva el ritmo moviendo la cabeza.

name: Noctowl
description_en: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.
description_es: Sus ojos están especialmente adaptados. Concentran la luz para poder ver en la oscuridad.

name: Ledyba
description_en: It is very timid. It will be afraid to move if it is alone. But it will be active if it is in a group.
description_es: Cuando llega el frío, se reúnen muchos Ledyba de todas partes para darse calor.

name: Ledian
description_en: When the stars flicker in the night sky, it flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.
description_es: Cuando parpadean las estrellas en el cielo nocturno, se mece desprendiendo un polvo brillante.

name: Spinarak
description_en: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.
description_es: Teje su telaraña con hilo fino pero resistente. Espera pacientemente a que caiga su presa.

name: Ariados
description_en: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It is hard to tell which end is which.
description_es: Teje su telaraña desde atrás y desde su boca. Es muy difícil saber dónde está cada cual.

name: Crobat
description_en: It flies so si­ lently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.
description_es: Es tan silencioso cuando vuela en la oscuridad con sus cuatro alas, que cuesta percibirlo cuando se acerca.

name: Chinchou
description_en: It shoots positive and negative elec­ tricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.
description_es: En el oscuro fondo del océano, su único modo de comunicarse es emitiendo luces parpadeantes.

name: Lanturn
description_en: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.
description_es: La luz de Lanturn se puede ver desde lo más profundo. Se le llama la Estrella de Alta Mar.

name: Pichu
description_en: It is not yet skilled at storing electricity. It may send out a jolt if amused or startled.
description_es: Cuando juegan, se tocan las colas y emiten chispas. Al parecer, es una prueba de valor.

name: Cleffa
description_en: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.
description_es: Por su inusual forma estrellada, la gente cree que procede de un meteorito que cayó a la tierra.

name: Igglybuff
description_en: It has a very soft body. If it starts to roll, it will bounce all over and be impossible to stop.
description_es: Para caminar, en lugar de usar los pies que tiene, opta por dar botes con su cuerpo redondo y blandito.

name: Togepi
description_en: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.
description_es: El cascarón parece estar lleno de alegría. Dicen que trae buena suerte si es tratado con cariño.

name: Togetic
description_en: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, car­ ing people and shower them with happiness.
description_es: Si no está con gente amable, se entristece. Puede flotar en el aire sin mover las alas.

name: Natu
description_en: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always star­ ing at something.
description_es: Va dando saltitos porque sus alas no han crecido lo suficiente. Siempre está pendiente de algo.

name: Xatu
description_en: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.
description_es: Cuando se pone a meditar al amanecer, pierde la noción del tiempo. Puede pasarse así todo el día.

name: Mareep
description_en: If static elec­ tricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.
description_es: Su pelaje lanudo dobla su volumen al acumular electricidad estática. Tocarlo puede dar calambre.

name: Flaaffy
description_en: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.
description_es: Su esponjosa lana almacena electricidad. Su piel gomosa evita que sea electrocutado.

name: Ampharos
description_en: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.
description_es: La punta de su cola reluce brillantemente y puede ser vista desde lejos. Es usado como faro.

name: Bellossom
description_en: BELLOSSOM gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.
description_es: Los Bellossom suelen reunirse para bailar. Dicen que sus danzas son un ritual para invocar al sol.

name: Marill
description_en: The tip of its tail, which con­ tains oil that is lighter than wa­ ter, lets it swim without drowning.
description_es: Tiene una piel que repele el agua. De hecho, puede pasarse horas jugando en el agua sin mojarse.

name: Azumarill
description_en: By keeping still and listening in­ tently, it can tell what is in even wild, fast- moving rivers.
description_es: Sus largas orejas son sensores que pueden percibir movimientos de seres vivos en el lecho del río.

name: Sudowoodo
description_en: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composi­ tion appears to be closer to a rock than a plant.
description_es: Aunque pretende ser un árbol, en su composición se parece más a una roca que a una planta.

name: Politoed
description_en: If POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL hear its echoing cry, they respond by gather­ ing from far and wide.
description_es: Cuando tres o más de estos se juntan, emiten un sonido muy fuerte parecido a un bramido.

name: Hoppip
description_en: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. They do enjoy gentle breezes, though.
description_es: Su cuerpo es tan ligero, que debe agarrarse bien al suelo con las patas para no irse con el viento.

name: Skiploom
description_en: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluc­ tuates up and down.
description_es: La flor de su cabeza se abre y cierra según suba o baje la temperatura.

name: Jumpluff
description_en: Once it catches the wind, it deft­ ly controls its cotton-puff spores to float, even around the world.
description_es: Los vientos estacionales lo llevan por todo el mundo, donde va soltando sus esporas.

name: Aipom
description_en: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.
description_es: Vive en lo alto de los árboles. Cuando salta de rama en rama, usa su cola para equilibrarse.

name: Sunkern
description_en: It may drop out of the sky suddenly. If attacked by a SPEAROW, it will violently shake its leaves.
description_es: Puede caer del cielo de repente. Si le ataca un Spearow, moverá violentamente sus hojas.

name: Sunflora
description_en: It converts sun­ light into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.
description_es: A medida que se acerca el verano, va adquiriendo un color más vivo e intenso en los pétalos de la cara.

name: Yanma
description_en: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter win­ dows in the area.
description_es: Su campo visual es de 360° sin girar la cabeza. Detecta hasta las presas que están a su espalda.

name: Wooper
description_en: This POKéMON lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.
description_es: Este Pokémon vive en aguas frías. Sale del agua para buscar comida cuando refresca el ambiente.

name: Quagsire
description_en: This carefree POKéMON has an easy-going nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.
description_es: Es un Pokémon bastante perezoso. Para pescar permanece en el fondo del río con la boca abierta.

name: Espeon
description_en: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its ene­ my's actions.
description_es: Al predecir el siguiente movimiento de su rival, chasquea el extremo de la cola bífida que tiene.

name: Umbreon
description_en: When agitated, this POKéMON pro­ tects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.
description_es: Creado cuando la luz lunar alteró la estructura genética de Eevee. Busca presas en la oscuridad.

name: Murkrow
description_en: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.
description_es: Esconde objetos brillantes en un lugar secreto. Meowth y Murkrow suelen saquear su escondite.

name: Slowking
description_en: It has incredible intellect and in­ tuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.
description_es: Su intelecto e intuición son increíbles. No pierde la compostura en ninguna situación.

name: Misdreavus
description_en: It likes playing mischievous tricks such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.
description_es: Se deleita con el miedo, que absorbe con sus esferas rojas. Por el día, duerme en la oscuridad.

name: Unown
description_en: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tab­ lets. It is said that the two are somehow related.
description_es: Su cuerpo fino y plano aparece siempre en los muros. Su forma parece tener algún significado.

name: Wobbuffet
description_en: It hates light and shock. If attack­ ed, it inflates its body to pump up its counter­ strike.
description_es: Odia la luz y las sacudidas. Si le atacan, infla su cuerpo para aumentar su contraataque.

name: Girafarig
description_en: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent and bite.
description_es: Cuando duerme, la cabeza de su cola se queda vigilando, ya que ella no necesita dormir.

name: Pineco
description_en: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.
description_es: Le gusta engrosar su coraza añadiendo cortezas de árbol. El aumento de peso no le molesta.

name: Forretress
description_en: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside the armor is a total mystery.
description_es: Se protege con su concha de acero de tal manera que solo se pueden ver sus ojos.

name: Dunsparce
description_en: When spotted, this POKéMON escapes backward by furi­ ously boring into the ground with its tail.
description_es: Este Pokémon escapa hacia atrás perforando el suelo con su cola, si es descubierto.

name: Gligar
description_en: It flies straight at its target's face then clamps down on the star­ tled victim to inject poison.
description_es: A veces se sujeta a los precipicios. Cuando divisa una presa, despliega sus alas y planea para atacar.

name: Steelix
description_en: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.
description_es: Su cuerpo es más duro que cualquier metal debido a la gran presión y calor de su hábitat.

name: Snubbull
description_en: Although it looks frightening, it is actually kind and affectionate. It is very popular among women.
description_es: Muy travieso por naturaleza, a muchas mujeres les gusta jugar con él porque es muy cariñoso.

name: Granbull
description_en: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If at­ tacked, it flails about to fend off its attacker.
description_es: A pesar de su aspecto, es muy tímido. Sin embargo, cuando se enfada, ataca con sus colmillos.

name: Qwilfish
description_en: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.
description_es: Para arrojar sus venenosas púas, infla su cuerpo bebiendo hasta diez litros de agua de una sola vez.

name: Scizor
description_en: It swings its eye- patterned pincers up to scare its foes. This makes it look like it has three heads.
description_es: Las pinzas que posee tienen acero. Con ellas, no hay nada que se le resista. Rompen todo lo que pillan.

name: Shuckle
description_en: The BERRIES it stores in its vase-like shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.
description_es: Las bayas que almacena en su caparazón con forma de tarro se convierten al final en un espeso zumo.

name: Heracross
description_en: This powerful POKéMON thrusts its prized horn under its enemies’ bellies then lifts and throws them.
description_es: Este fuerte Pokémon clava su preciado cuerno en la tripa del enemigo, lo eleva y luego lo arroja.

name: Sneasel
description_en: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it sud­ denly extends the claws and startles its enemy.
description_es: Se alimenta de huevos robados en nidos. Clava sus afiladas garras en los puntos débiles de sus rivales.

name: Teddiursa
description_en: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they are soaked with honey.
description_es: Si encuentra miel, brillará la marca de su frente. Se lame las garras cuando están llenas de miel.

name: Ursaring
description_en: Although it is a good climber, it prefers to snap trees with its forelegs and eat fallen BERRIES.
description_es: Capaz de percibir cualquier tipo de aroma, encuentra sin problemas todo alimento enterrado bajo tierra.

name: Slugma
description_en: It never sleeps. It has to keep moving because if it stopped, its magma body would cool and harden.
description_es: Asiduo a las zonas volcánicas, se desliza lentamente en busca de lugares calientes.

name: Magcargo
description_en: The shell on its back is just skin that has cooled and hardened. It breaks easily with a slight touch.
description_es: En ocasiones, su resbaladiza concha lanza intensas llamaradas que recorren todo su cuerpo.

name: Swinub
description_en: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.
description_es: Frota su hocico contra el suelo para desenterrar comida. A veces descubre aguas termales.

name: Piloswine
description_en: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.
description_es: Aunque tiene las patas cortas, las fuertes pezuñas le permiten agarrarse bien al suelo, a pesar del hielo.

name: Corsola
description_en: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure for its beauty.
description_es: Crece y muda continuamente. La parte superior de su cabeza es muy apreciada por su belleza.

name: Remoraid
description_en: It has superb ac­ curacy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.
description_es: Tiene muy buena puntería. Dispara agua a sus presas, hasta si se están moviendo, a más de 100 metros.

name: Octillery
description_en: It traps enemies with its suction- cupped tentacles then smashes them with its rock-hard head.
description_es: Tiene querencia por los agujeros. Ataca escupiendo tinta metido en las grietas de rocas o en recipientes.

name: Delibird
description_en: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.
description_es: Transporta alimentos en su cola enrollada. Le gusta compartir su comida con los montañistas perdidos.

name: Mantine
description_en: As it majestically swims, it doesn't care if REMORAID attach to it for scavenging its leftovers.
description_es: Acumula velocidad nadando y puede saltar fuera del agua, alcanzando 100 metros de altura, para descender luego planeando.

name: Skarmory
description_en: Its sturdy wings look heavy, but they are actually hollow and light, allowing it to fly freely in the sky.
description_es: Después de anidar en zarzas, las alas de sus polluelos crecen fortalecidas por los rasguños.

name: Houndour
description_en: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.
description_es: Al amanecer, resuena por la zona su inquietante aullido para anunciar que es su territorio.

name: Houndoom
description_en: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.
description_es: Hace mucho, la gente creía que sus horripilantes aullidos eran de la muerte personificada.

name: Kingdra
description_en: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.
description_es: Dicen que suele esconderse en cuevas submarinas. Puede crear torbellinos al bostezar.

name: Phanpy
description_en: It swings its long snout around play­ fully, but because it is so strong, that can be dan­ gerous.
description_es: Como muestra de afecto, golpea con su trompa. Aunque es tan fuerte que te mandará lejos.

name: Donphan
description_en: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its TACKLE is strong enough to knock down a house.
description_es: Tiene afilados y duros colmillos, y una gruesa piel. Su Placaje es tan fuerte que puede derribar una casa.

name: Porygon2
description_en: This upgraded version of PORYGON is designed for space exploration. It can't fly, though.
description_es: La investigación mejoró sus habilidades. A veces, puede actuar de forma no programada.

name: Stantler
description_en: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where real­ ity is distorted.
description_es: Mirar a su cornamenta provoca una extraña sensación de pérdida de equilibrio.

name: Smeargle
description_en: A special fluid oozes from the tip of its tail. It paints the fluid everywhere to mark its territory.
description_es: Marca su territorio usando su cola a modo de pincel. Ha hecho más de 5000 marcas diferentes.

name: Tyrogue
description_en: It is always bursting with en­ ergy. To make it­ self stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.
description_es: Ataca siempre con mucha energía. Para fortalecerse a sí mismo, sigue luchando aunque pierda.

name: Hitmontop
description_en: If you become enchanted by its smooth, elegant, dance-like kicks, you may get drilled hard.
description_es: Gira a gran velocidad al luchar. La fuerza centrífuga multiplica su poder de destrucción por diez.

name: Smoochum
description_en: Its lips are the most sensitive parts on its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.
description_es: Sus labios son la parte más sensible de su cuerpo. Siempre los usa para examinar las cosas.

name: Elekid
description_en: It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it charges up only a little bit.
description_es: Genera electricidad girando los brazos. No obstante, es incapaz de almacenar la energía creada.

name: Magby
description_en: Each and every time it inhales and exhales, hot embers dribble out of its mouth and nostrils.
description_es: Es pequeño, pero su cuerpo puede llegar a alcanzar 600 °C. Cuando inspira y espira, expulsa llamas por la nariz y por la boca.

name: Miltank
description_en: Its milk is packed with nutrition, making it the ultimate beverage for the sick or weary.
description_es: Si tiene crías, la leche que produce contiene muchos más nutrientes de lo normal.

name: Blissey
description_en: Anyone who takes even one bite of BLISSEY's egg be­ comes unfailingly caring and pleas­ ant to everyone.
description_es: Los huevos que pone están llenos de felicidad. Solo con probar un poquito de uno, cualquiera sonríe.

name: Raikou
description_en: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.
description_es: Las nubes de lluvia que lleva le permiten lanzar rayos a voluntad. Dicen que apareció con un rayo.

name: Entei
description_en: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Un­ able to restrain its extreme power, it races headlong around the land.
description_es: Un Pokémon que corre por la tierra. Dicen que siempre nace uno cuando aparece un nuevo volcán.

name: Suicune
description_en: Said to be the reincarnation of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.
description_es: Recorre el mundo para purificar agua contaminada. Corre veloz con el viento del norte.

name: Larvitar
description_en: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.
description_es: Se alimenta de tierra. Después de comer una gran montaña, se duerme y empieza a crecer.

name: Pupitar
description_en: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its THRASHING can topple a mountain.
description_es: Su cuerpo es duro como la roca. Se autopropulsa como un cohete soltando los gases de su interior.

name: Tyranitar
description_en: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.
description_es: En una de sus poderosas garras tiene el poder de hacer temblar la tierra y las montañas.

name: Lugia
description_en: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea because its powers are too strong.
description_es: Duerme en una dorsal marina. Si bate sus alas, puede causar tormentas de 40 días.

name: Ho-oh
description_en: Legends claim this POKéMON flies the world's skies con­ tinuously on its magnificent seven- colored wings.
description_es: Cuenta la leyenda que brilla en siete colores. Dicen que deja un arcoíris tras de sí al volar.

name: Celebi
description_en: This POKéMON wan­ ders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.
description_es: Este Pokémon vaga por el tiempo. La hierba y los árboles crecen por los campos por donde pasa.

name: Treecko
description_en: TREECKO has small hooks on the bottom of its feet that enable it to scale vertical walls. This POKéMON attacks by slamming foes with its thick tail.
description_es: Escala superficies verticales muy rápido. Con la cola detecta la humedad y prevé el tiempo que va a hacer.

name: Grovyle
description_en: The leaves growing out of GROVYLE’s body are convenient for camouflaging it from enemies in the forest. This POKéMON is a master at climbing trees in jungles.
description_es: Los desarrollados músculos que tiene en las extremidades inferiores le hacen ser muy ágil y le permiten dar grandes saltos.

name: Sceptile
description_en: The leaves growing on SCEPTILE’s body are very sharp edged. This POKéMON is very agile - it leaps all over the branches of trees and jumps on its foe from above or behind.
description_es: Las hojas de sus brazos pueden cortar gruesos árboles. Invencible en los combates en la jungla.

name: Torchic
description_en: TORCHIC sticks with its TRAINER, following behind with unsteady steps. This POKéMON breathes fire of over 1,800 degrees F, including fireballs that leave the foe scorched black.
description_es: En su interior, guarda una llama que arde sin cesar. Si se le abraza, se nota que tiene una temperatura muy alta.

name: Combusken
description_en: COMBUSKEN toughens up its legs and thighs by running through fields and mountains. This POKéMON’s legs possess both speed and power, enabling it to dole out ten kicks in one second.
description_es: Su habilidad le permite dar diez patadas por segundo. Lanza potentes gritos para intimidar.

name: Blaziken
description_en: In battle, BLAZIKEN blows out intense flames from its wrists and attacks foes courageously. The stronger the foe, the more intensely this POKéMON’s wrists burn.
description_es: Puede saltar edificios de 30 plantas. Con sus golpes de fuego quema a sus rivales.

name: Mudkip
description_en: The fin on MUDKIP’s head acts as highly sensitive radar. Using this fin to sense movements of water and air, this POKéMON can determine what is taking place around it without using its eyes.
description_es: Tiene una larga cola que le propulsa por el agua con mucha potencia. A pesar de ser pequeño, tiene mucha fuerza.

name: Marshtomp
description_en: The surface of MARSHTOMP’s body is enveloped by a thin, sticky film that enables it to live on land. This POKéMON plays in mud on beaches when the ocean tide is low.
description_es: Sus piernas robustas impiden que pierda el equilibrio y caiga, incluso en el barro. Duerme bajo la arena.

name: Swampert
description_en: SWAMPERT is very strong. It has enough power to easily drag a boulder weighing more than a ton. This POKéMON also has powerful vision that lets it see even in murky water.
description_es: Con sus brazos duros como el acero puede partir rocas gigantescas en mil pedazos de un solo golpe.

name: Poochyena
description_en: At first sight, POOCHYENA takes a bite at anything that moves. This POKéMON chases after prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it may turn tail if the prey strikes back.
description_es: Es muy persistente. Si se fija en una presa, no la dejará hasta que caiga agotada.

name: Mightyena
description_en: MIGHTYENA gives obvious signals when it is preparing to attack. It starts to growl deeply and then flattens its body. This POKéMON will bite savagely with its sharply pointed fangs.
description_es: Siempre obedece a los buenos Entrenadores. Está acostumbrado a vivir en jaurías en estado salvaje.

name: Zigzagoon
description_en: ZIGZAGOON restlessly wanders everywhere at all times. This POKéMON does so because it is very curious. It becomes interested in anything that it happens to see.
description_es: Se mueve en zigzag. Se le da bien encontrar objetos ocultos en la hierba e incluso enterrados.

name: Linoone
description_en: LINOONE always runs full speed and only in straight lines. If facing an obstacle, it makes a right-angle turn to evade it. This POKéMON is very challenged by gently curving roads.
description_es: En línea recta corre a algo más de 100 km/h, pero no es tan hábil si hay curvas de por medio.

name: Wurmple
description_en: Using the spikes on its rear end, WURMPLE peels the bark off trees and feeds on the sap that oozes out. This POKéMON’s feet are tipped with suction pads that allow it to cling to glass without slipping.
description_es: Le encanta comer hojas. Si le ataca un Starly, se defenderá con sus púas.

name: Silcoon
description_en: SILCOON tethers itself to a tree branch using silk to keep from falling. There, this POKéMON hangs quietly while it awaits evolution. It peers out of the silk cocoon through a small hole.
description_es: Se agarra con su seda a las ramas de un árbol y espera su evolución bebiendo agua de lluvia.

name: Beautifly
description_en: BEAUTIFLY’s favorite food is the sweet pollen of flowers. If you want to see this POKéMON, just leave a potted flower by an open window. BEAUTIFLY is sure to come looking for pollen.
description_es: Los dibujos de sus coloridas alas son muy peculiares. Liba el néctar de las flores con su fina trompa.

name: Cascoon
description_en: CASCOON makes its protective cocoon by wrapping its body entirely with a fine silk from its mouth. Once the silk goes around its body, it hardens. This POKéMON prepares for its evolution inside the cocoon.
description_es: Está formado por seda que se endurece poco a poco. Si se resquebraja el capullo, está a punto de evolucionar.

name: Dustox
description_en: DUSTOX is instinctively drawn to light. Swarms of this POKéMON are attracted by the bright lights of cities, where they wreak havoc by stripping the leaves off roadside trees for food.
description_es: Pokémon nocturno. Atraído por las luces de la ciudad, se come las hojas y arbustos de las avenidas.

name: Lotad
description_en: LOTAD live in ponds and lakes, where they float on the surface. It grows weak if its broad leaf dies. On rare occasions, this POKéMON travels on land in search of clean water.
description_es: Parece una planta acuática. Hace de ferry para los Pokémon que no saben nadar.

name: Lombre
description_en: LOMBRE is nocturnal - it will get active after dusk. It is also a mischief-maker. When this POKéMON spots anglers, it tugs on their fishing lines from beneath the surface and enjoys their consternation.
description_es: Vive en el agua y, cuando hace sol, se queda en la orilla. De día duerme sobre las algas y de noche entra en acción.

name: Ludicolo
description_en: LUDICOLO begins dancing as soon as it hears cheerful, festive music. This POKéMON is said to appear when it hears the singing of children on hiking outings.
description_es: Cuando oye música alegre, sus músculos se llenan de energía, y no puede evitar ponerse a bailar.

name: Seedot
description_en: SEEDOT attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. It sucks moisture from the tree while hanging off the branch. The more water it drinks, the glossier this POKéMON’s body becomes.
description_es: Se cuelga de las ramas con el extremo de su cabeza. A veces se cae cuando soplan vientos fuertes.

name: Nuzleaf
description_en: NUZLEAF live in densely overgrown forests. They occasionally venture out of the forest to startle people. This POKéMON dislikes having its long nose pinched.
description_es: Cuando usa la hoja de su cabeza como flauta, asusta a la gente. Vive en lo más profundo de los bosques.

name: Shiftry
description_en: SHIFTRY is a mysterious POKéMON that is said to live atop towering trees dating back over a thousand years. It creates terrific windstorms with the fans it holds.
description_es: Habita los bosques y se le tiene miedo. Es capaz de leer los pensamientos del rival y actuar en consecuencia.

name: Taillow
description_en: TAILLOW courageously stands its ground against foes, however strong they may be. This gutsy POKéMON will remain defiant even after a loss. On the other hand, it cries loudly if it becomes hungry.
description_es: Es un Pokémon valiente que no teme a los rivales fuertes. Vuela en busca de climas templados.

name: Swellow
description_en: SWELLOW flies high above our heads, making graceful arcs in the sky. This POKéMON dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. The hapless prey is tightly grasped by SWELLOW’s clawed feet, preventing escape.
description_es: Cuando se encuentra bien, pone firmes las plumas de la cola doble que tiene. Remonta el vuelo de forma muy elegante.

name: Wingull
description_en: WINGULL has the habit of carrying prey and valuables in its beak and hiding them in all sorts of locations. This POKéMON rides the winds and flies as if it were skating across the sky.
description_es: Sus largas alas aprovechan los vientos marinos para planear. Cuando descansa, las pliega.

name: Pelipper
description_en: PELIPPER is a flying transporter that carries small POKéMON and eggs inside its massive bill. This POKéMON builds its nest on steep cliffs facing the sea.
description_es: Hunde su gran pico en el mar para sacar numerosas presas junto con mucha agua.

name: Ralts
description_en: RALTS senses the emotions of people using the horns on its head. This POKéMON rarely appears before people. But when it does, it draws closer if it senses that the person has a positive disposition.
description_es: Si sus cuernos perciben emociones positivas de personas o Pokémon, su cuerpo se calienta un poco.

name: Kirlia
description_en: It is said that a KIRLIA that is exposed to the positive emotions of its TRAINER grows beautiful. This POKéMON controls psychokinetic powers with its highly developed brain.
description_es: Al percibir la alegría de su Entrenador refuerza sus ataques psicoquinéticos. Cuando está contento, da vueltas y baila.

name: Gardevoir
description_en: GARDEVOIR has the ability to read the future. If it senses impending danger to its TRAINER, this POKéMON is said to unleash its psychokinetic energy at full power.
description_es: Para proteger a su Entrenador, emplea todo su poder psíquico en crear un pequeño agujero negro.

name: Surskit
description_en: From the tips of its feet, SURSKIT secretes an oil that enables it to walk on water as if it were skating. This POKéMON feeds on microscopic organisms in ponds and lakes.
description_es: Vive en estanques, pero cuando se desata una tormenta puede aparecer en los charcos que se forman en las ciudades.

name: Masquerain
description_en: MASQUERAIN intimidates enemies with the eyelike patterns on its antennas. This POKéMON flaps its four wings to freely fly in any direction - even sideways and backwards - as if it were a helicopter.
description_es: Sus antenas tienen dibujos de ojos, mientras que sus alas le permiten volar en cualquier dirección.

name: Shroomish
description_en: SHROOMISH live in damp soil in the dark depths of forests. They are often found keeping still under fallen leaves. This POKéMON feeds on compost that is made up of fallen, rotted leaves.
description_es: Prefiere los sitios húmedos. De día está tranquilamente en el bosque, a la sombra. Expulsa polvo tóxico por la cabeza.

name: Breloom
description_en: BRELOOM closes in on its foe with light and sprightly footwork, then throws punches with its stretchy arms. This POKéMON’s fighting technique puts boxers to shame.
description_es: Sus cortos brazos se expanden cuando da puñetazos. Tiene una técnica pugilística muy depurada.

name: Slakoth
description_en: SLAKOTH lolls around for over twenty hours every day. Because it moves so little, it does not need much food. This POKéMON’s sole daily meal consists of just three leaves.
description_es: Slakoth se pasa todo el día holgazaneando y solo con verlo a uno le entra mucha pereza.

name: Vigoroth
description_en: VIGOROTH is always itching and agitated to go on a wild rampage. It simply can’t tolerate sitting still for even a minute. This POKéMON’s stress level rises if it can’t be moving constantly.
description_es: Su corazón palpita a un ritmo frenético, haciendo que su sangre bulla, así que no puede estarse quieto ni un segundo.

name: Slaking
description_en: SLAKING spends all day lying down and lolling about. It eats grass growing within its reach. If it eats all the grass it can reach, this POKéMON reluctantly moves to another spot.
description_es: El Pokémon más perezoso del mundo. Cambia de lugar para coger la comida al alcance de su mano.

name: Nincada
description_en: NINCADA lives underground for many years in complete darkness. This POKéMON absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees. It stays motionless as it waits for evolution.
description_es: Como se ha pasado casi toda la vida viviendo bajo tierra, no ve bien. Las antenas que tiene le ayudan a orientarse.

name: Ninjask
description_en: NINJASK moves around at such a high speed that it cannot be seen, even while its crying can be clearly heard. For that reason, this POKéMON was long believed to be invisible.
description_es: Escuchar su zumbido de forma continuada provoca jaquecas. Casi no se le ve de lo rápido que es.

name: Shedinja
description_en: SHEDINJA’s hard body doesn’t move - not even a twitch. In fact, its body appears to be merely a hollow shell. It is believed that this POKéMON will steal the spirit of anyone peering into its hollow body from its back.
description_es: Es el caparazón de un bicho que cobró vida. Si alguien lo mira por la espalda, le robará el alma.

name: Whismur
description_en: Normally, WHISMUR’s voice is very quiet - it is barely audible even if one is paying close attention. However, if this POKéMON senses danger, it starts crying at an earsplitting volume.
description_es: Normalmente murmulla, pero cuando siente que hay peligro se pone a chillar. Solo para cuando se le cierran las orejas.

name: Loudred
description_en: LOUDRED’s bellowing can completely decimate a wood-frame house. It uses its voice to punish its foes. This POKéMON’s round ears serve as loudspeakers.
description_es: Aspira profundamente y luego, usando sus fuertes abdominales, suelta un potente vozarrón.

name: Exploud
description_en: EXPLOUD triggers earthquakes with the tremors it creates by bellowing. If this POKéMON violently inhales from the ports on its body, it’s a sign that it is preparing to let loose a huge bellow.
description_es: Su aullido se puede oír a 10 km. Emite todo tipo de sonidos desde los tubos de su cuerpo.

name: Makuhita
description_en: MAKUHITA is tenacious - it will keep getting up and attacking its foe however many times it is knocked down. Every time it gets back up, this POKéMON stores more energy in its body for evolving.
description_es: Endurece su cuerpo golpeando grandes árboles sin perder jamás el ánimo.

name: Hariyama
description_en: HARIYAMA practices its straight-arm slaps in any number of locations. One hit of this POKéMON’s powerful, openhanded, straight-arm punches could snap a telephone pole in two.
description_es: Para aumentar su fuerza, da un pisotón en el suelo. Puede lanzar un camión de 10 toneladas por los aires de un puñetazo.

name: Azurill
description_en: AZURILL spins its tail as if it were a lasso, then hurls it far. The momentum of the throw sends its body flying, too. Using this unique action, one of these POKéMON managed to hurl itself a record 33 feet.
description_es: Vive cerca del agua. En la tierra se mueve muy rápido botando sobre su gran cola.

name: Nosepass
description_en: NOSEPASS’s magnetic nose is always pointed to the north. If two of these POKéMON meet, they cannot turn their faces to each other when they are close because their magnetic noses repel one another.
description_es: Siempre apunta al norte con su nariz imantada. Con ella reviste su cuerpo de objetos metálicos para protegerse.

name: Skitty
description_en: SKITTY has the habit of becoming fascinated by moving objects and chasing them around. This POKéMON is known to chase after its own tail and become dizzy.
description_es: No puede evitar ir tras las cosas que se mueven. Hasta corre en círculos persiguiéndose la cola.

name: Delcatty
description_en: DELCATTY prefers to live an unfettered existence in which it can do as it pleases at its own pace. Because this POKéMON eats and sleeps whenever it decides, its daily routines are completely random.
description_es: No soporta los lugares sucios. Le encanta acicalarse el pelaje cuando está a gusto en un sitio.

name: Sableye
description_en: SABLEYE lead quiet lives deep inside caverns. They are feared, however, because these POKéMON are thought to steal the spirits of people when their eyes burn with a sinister glow in the darkness.
description_es: Se oculta en cavernas oscuras. De tanto comer gemas, sus ojos son piedras preciosas.

name: Mawile
description_en: MAWHILE’s huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed. Its docile-looking face serves to lull its foe into letting down its guard. When the foe least expects it, MAWHILE chomps it with its gaping jaws.
description_es: Engaña con su aspecto dócil; hace que el rival se confíe y le da un mordisco con sus enormes e implacables mandíbulas.

name: Aron
description_en: This POKéMON has a body of steel. To make its body, ARON feeds on iron ore that it digs from mountains. Occasionally, it causes major trouble by eating bridges and rails.
description_es: Suele vivir en lugares inaccesibles de las montañas, pero el hambre lo empuja a comer raíles y coches.

name: Lairon
description_en: LAIRON tempers its steel body by drinking highly nutritious mineral springwater until it is bloated. This POKéMON makes its nest close to springs of delicious water.
description_es: Le encanta comer hierro. Lucha por su territorio embistiendo a sus rivales con su cuerpo de acero.

name: Aggron
description_en: AGGRON claims an entire mountain as its own territory. It mercilessly beats up anything that violates its environment. This POKéMON vigilantly patrols its territory at all times.
description_es: Hacen de toda una montaña su territorio. Cuantas más cicatrices tienen, más curtidos en disputas. ¡Mucha atención!

name: Meditite
description_en: MEDITITE undertakes rigorous mental training deep in the mountains. However, whenever it meditates, this POKéMON always loses its concentration and focus. As a result, its training never ends.
description_es: Se entrena en la profundidad de las montañas. Cuando aumenta su poder espiritual con meditación, levita.

name: Medicham
description_en: It is said that through meditation, MEDICHAM heightens energy inside its body and sharpens its sixth sense. This POKéMON hides its presence by merging itself with fields and mountains.
description_es: Evita los ataques moviéndose de forma elegante, como si bailara. Ataca dando un golpe devastador y moviéndose igual.

name: Electrike
description_en: ELECTRIKE stores electricity in its long body hair. This POKéMON stimulates its leg muscles with electric charges. These jolts of power give its legs explosive acceleration performance.
description_es: Estimula sus músculos y aumenta sus reflejos con la electricidad que almacena su pelaje.

name: Manectric
description_en: MANECTRIC is constantly discharging electricity from its mane. The sparks sometimes ignite forest fires. When it enters a battle, this POKéMON creates thunderclouds.
description_es: No suele aparecer ante la gente. Dicen que suele colocar su nido donde caen los rayos.

name: Plusle
description_en: PLUSLE always acts as a cheerleader for its partners. Whenever a teammate puts out a good effort in battle, this POKéMON shorts out its body to create the crackling noises of sparks to show its joy.
description_es: Anima a sus compañeros con pompones de chispas. Roba energía de los postes telefónicos.

name: Minun
