description_en: MINUN is more concerned about cheering on its partners than its own safety. It shorts out the electricity in its body to create brilliant showers of sparks to cheer on its teammates.
description_es: La electricidad de Minun y Plusle es buena para la circulación y para desentumecer músculos.

name: Volbeat
description_en: With the arrival of night, VOLBEAT emits light from its tail. It communicates with others by adjusting the intensity and flashing of its light. This POKéMON is attracted by the sweet aroma of ILLUMISE.
description_es: Se comunica con otros iluminando su cola por la noche. Le encanta el suave aroma de Illumise.

name: Illumise
description_en: ILLUMISE attracts a swarm of VOLBEAT using a sweet fragrance. Once the VOLBEAT have gathered, this POKéMON leads the lit-up swarm in drawing geometric designs on the canvas of the night sky.
description_es: Con su dulce aroma guía a grupos de Volbeat para que tracen hasta 200 dibujos distintos en el cielo nocturno.

name: Roselia
description_en: ROSELIA shoots sharp thorns as projectiles at any opponent that tries to steal the flowers on its arms. The aroma of this POKéMON brings serenity to living things.
description_es: Ataca con sus manos, en las que tiene un tipo de veneno diferente en cada una. Cuanto más aroma, mejor salud tiene.

name: Gulpin
description_en: Virtually all of GULPIN’s body is its stomach. As a result, it can swallow something its own size. This POKéMON’s stomach contains a special fluid that digests anything.
description_es: Sus sesos y corazón son diminutos; es casi todo estómago. Sus jugos gástricos disuelven lo que sea.

name: Swalot
description_en: When SWALOT spots prey, it spurts out a hideously toxic fluid from its pores and sprays the target. Once the prey has weakened, this POKéMON gulps it down whole with its cavernous mouth.
description_es: Se traga cualquier cosa de una pieza. Sus poros segregan fluidos tóxicos que dañan a sus enemigos.

name: Carvanha
description_en: CARVANHA’s strongly developed jaws and its sharply pointed fangs pack the destructive power to rip out boat hulls. Many boats have been attacked and sunk by this POKéMON.
description_es: Atacan en grupo a los barcos y los hunden a base de bocados. Habitan en los ríos de la jungla.

name: Sharpedo
description_en: Nicknamed “the bully of the sea,” SHARPEDO is widely feared. Its cruel fangs grow back immediately if they snap off. Just one of these POKéMON can thoroughly tear apart a supertanker.
description_es: Con sus colmillos puede atravesar el acero. Nada a 120 km/h. Le llaman el Terror de los Mares.

name: Wailmer
description_en: WAILMER’s nostrils are located above its eyes. This playful POKéMON loves to startle people by forcefully snorting out seawater it stores inside its body out of its nostrils.
description_es: Le gusta botar como una pelota de playa. Cuanta más agua de mar traga, más alto puede llegar.

name: Wailord
description_en: WAILORD is the largest of all identified POKéMON up to now. This giant POKéMON swims languorously in the vast open sea, eating massive amounts of food at once with its enormous mouth.
description_es: Puede dejar fuera de combate a sus oponentes con el impacto de su enorme cuerpo al caer en el agua tras un salto.

name: Numel
description_en: NUMEL is extremely dull witted - it doesn’t notice being hit. However, it can’t stand hunger for even a second. This POKéMON’s body is a seething cauldron of boiling magma.
description_es: En su joroba almacena magma ardiente que se enfría cuando llueve y lo ralentiza.

name: Camerupt
description_en: CAMERUPT has a volcano inside its body. Magma of 18,000 degrees F courses through its body. Occasionally, the humps on this POKéMON’s back erupt, spewing the superheated magma.
description_es: Los volcanes de su joroba entran en erupción cada 10 años o cuando Camerupt se enfada mucho.

name: Torkoal
description_en: TORKOAL digs through mountains in search of coal. If it finds some, it fills hollow spaces on its shell with the coal and burns it. If it is attacked, this POKéMON spouts thick black smoke to beat a retreat.
description_es: Trabaja sin descanso en minas en desuso localizando y extrayendo carbón.

name: Spoink
description_en: SPOINK bounces around on its tail. The shock of its bouncing makes its heart pump. As a result, this POKéMON cannot afford to stop bouncing - if it stops, its heart will stop.
description_es: Bota continuamente usando su cola como muelle. Salta para mantener el latido de su corazón.

name: Grumpig
description_en: GRUMPIG uses the black pearls on its body to amplify its psychic power waves for gaining total control over its foe. When this POKéMON uses its special power, its snorting breath grows labored.
description_es: Las perlas negras aumentan sus poderes psíquicos. Controla las mentes de sus rivales con un extraño baile.

name: Spinda
description_en: All the SPINDA that exist in the world are said to have utterly unique spot patterns. The shaky, tottering steps of this POKéMON give it the appearance of dancing.
description_es: No hay dos Spinda que tengan idénticos pelajes. Su tambaleo al bailar confunde a los rivales.

name: Trapinch
description_en: TRAPINCH’s nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit dug in sand. This POKéMON patiently waits for prey to tumble down the pit. Its giant jaws have enough strength to crush even boulders.
description_es: Habita desiertos áridos. Cava fosas profundas, en las que espera que caiga su presa.

name: Vibrava
description_en: To make prey faint, VIBRAVA generates ultrasonic waves by vigorously making its two wings vibrate. This POKéMON’s ultrasonic waves are so powerful, they can bring on headaches in people.
description_es: Al agitar a gran velocidad ambas alas, emite ondas ultrasónicas que provocan fuertes dolores de cabeza.

name: Flygon
description_en: FLYGON is nicknamed “the elemental spirit of the desert.” Because its flapping wings whip up a cloud of sand, this POKéMON is always enveloped in a sandstorm while flying.
description_es: Su medio es el desierto. Para esconderse, levanta arena con las patas. Tiene los ojos protegidos con mallas rojas.

name: Cacnea
description_en: CACNEA lives in arid locations such as deserts. It releases a strong aroma from its flower to attract prey. When prey comes near, this POKéMON shoots sharp thorns from its body to bring the victim down.
description_es: Vive en regiones secas y con pocas lluvias. Una vez al año, le brota una flor amarilla.

name: Cacturne
description_en: During the daytime, CACTURNE remains unmoving so that it does not lose any moisture to the harsh desert sun. This POKéMON becomes active at night when the temperature drops.
description_es: Es un Pokémon nocturno. Busca presas agotadas por el calor diurno del desierto.

name: Swablu
description_en: SWABLU has light and fluffy wings that are like cottony clouds. This POKéMON is not frightened of people. It lands on the heads of people and sits there like a cotton-fluff hat.
description_es: Se desconoce el porqué, pero le encanta posarse sobre la cabeza de los humanos y fingir que es un gorro.

name: Altaria
description_en: ALTARIA dances and wheels through the sky among billowing, cotton-like clouds. By singing melodies in its crystal-clear voice, this POKéMON makes its listeners experience dreamy wonderment.
description_es: Vuela pausadamente por el cielo azul. Su hermoso trino cautiva a todo aquel que lo escucha.

name: Zangoose
description_en: Memories of battling its arch-rival SEVIPER are etched into every cell of ZANGOOSE’s body. This POKéMON adroitly dodges attacks with incredible agility.
description_es: Hace muchos años que se enfrenta a Seviper. Su arma más eficaz son sus zarpas afiladas.

name: Seviper
description_en: SEVIPER shares a generations-long feud with ZANGOOSE. The scars on its body are evidence of vicious battles. This POKéMON attacks using its sword- edged tail.
description_es: Hace frente a Zangoose con su agilidad y su afilada cola, que está cargada con un veneno letal.

name: Lunatone
description_en: LUNATONE was discovered at a location where a meteorite fell. As a result, some people theorize that this POKéMON came from space. However, no one has been able to prove this theory so far.
description_es: Se piensa que está muy influido por las fases lunares, ya que solo actúa en noches de luna llena.

name: Solrock
description_en: SOLROCK is a new species of POKéMON that is said to have fallen from space. It floats in air and moves silently. In battle, this POKéMON releases intensely bright light.
description_es: Usa el sol como fuente de energía, por lo que es más poderoso de día. Brilla al rotar.

name: Barboach
description_en: BARBOACH’s sensitive whiskers serve as a superb radar system. This POKéMON hides in mud, leaving only its two whiskers exposed while it waits for prey to come along.
description_es: Recubre su cuerpo de una película viscosa que le permite escapar si alguien lo agarra.

name: Whiscash
description_en: WHISCASH is extremely territorial. Just one of these POKéMON will claim a large pond as its exclusive territory. If a foe approaches it, it thrashes about and triggers a massive earthquake.
description_es: Habita en grandes pantanos. Si se acerca un enemigo, se alborota y causa temblores monumentales.

name: Corphish
description_en: CORPHISH were originally foreign POKéMON that were imported as pets. They eventually turned up in the wild. This POKéMON is very hardy and has greatly increased its population.
description_es: Por sucio o contaminado que esté el río, se adaptan rápido y se multiplican. Poseen una gran fuerza vital.

name: Crawdaunt
description_en: CRAWDAUNT has an extremely violent nature that compels it to challenge other living things to battle. Other life-forms refuse to live in ponds inhabited by this POKéMON, making them desolate places.
description_es: Este malandrín usa sus pinzas para atosigar y expulsar a los otros Pokémon que viven en su estanque.

name: Baltoy
description_en: BALTOY moves while spinning around on its one foot. Primitive wall paintings depicting this POKéMON living among people were discovered in some ancient ruins.
description_es: Se mueve girando sobre su eje. También se le puede ver girando cabeza abajo.

name: Claydol
description_en: CLAYDOL are said to be dolls of mud made by primitive humans and brought to life by exposure to a mysterious ray. This POKéMON moves about while levitating.
description_es: Este Pokémon es una vieja figurilla de barro que cobró vida mediante la exposición a extraños rayos de luz.

name: Lileep
description_en: LILEEP became extinct approximately a hundred million years ago. This ancient POKéMON attaches itself to a rock on the seafloor and catches approaching prey using tentacles shaped like flower petals.
description_es: Se extinguió hace 100 millones de años. Sus tentáculos parecen pétalos para atraer a sus presas.

name: Cradily
description_en: CRADILY roams around the ocean floor in search of food. This POKéMON freely extends its tree trunk-like neck and captures unwary prey using its eight tentacles.
description_es: Vive en el fondo de los mares de aguas templadas. Emerge para cazar cuando baja la marea.

name: Anorith
description_en: ANORITH was regenerated from a prehistoric fossil. This primitive POKéMON once lived in warm seas. It grips its prey firmly between its two large claws.
description_es: Es una especie de Pokémon predecesor. Estira las pinzas para cazar a sus presas, que se esconden en las rocas del mar.

name: Armaldo
description_en: ARMALDO’s tough armor makes all attacks bounce off. This POKéMON’s two enormous claws can be freely extended or contracted. They have the power to punch right through a steel slab.
description_es: Ensarta a sus presas con sus gigantescas garras elásticas. Una fuerte coraza cubre su cuerpo.

name: Feebas
description_en: FEEBAS’s fins are ragged and tattered from the start of its life. Because of its shoddy appearance, this POKéMON is largely ignored. It is capable of living in both the sea and in rivers.
description_es: Come de todo, por lo que puede vivir en aguas contaminadas. Nadie le presta atención.

name: Milotic
description_en: MILOTIC is said to be the most beautiful of all the POKéMON. It has the power to becalm such emotions as anger and hostility to quell bitter feuding.
description_es: Milotic es impresionantemente bello. Quienes lo ven, temen perder las ganas de luchar contra él.

name: Castform
description_en: CASTFORM’s appearance changes with the weather. This POKéMON gained the ability to use the vast power of nature to protect its tiny body.
description_es: Sus células son muy sensibles a los cambios de temperatura y humedad y se adapta sin problema.

name: Kecleon
description_en: KECLEON is capable of changing its body colors at will to blend in with its surroundings. There is one exception - this POKéMON can’t change the zigzag pattern on its belly.
description_es: Puede mudar el color de su cuerpo a voluntad, pero el dibujo en zigzag de su panza nunca desaparece.

name: Shuppet
description_en: SHUPPET is attracted by feelings of jealousy and vindictiveness. If someone develops strong feelings of vengeance, this POKéMON will appear in a swarm and line up beneath the eaves of that person’s home.
description_es: Dicen que con su cuerno se alimenta de sentimientos de celos y envidia. Es muy activo a medianoche.

name: Banette
description_en: BANETTE generates energy for laying strong curses by sticking pins into its own body. This POKéMON was originally a pitiful plush doll that was thrown away.
description_es: Este muñeco se convirtió en un Pokémon cuando lo tiraron a la basura. Busca a su antiguo dueño.

name: Duskull
description_en: DUSKULL can pass through any wall no matter how thick it may be. Once this POKéMON chooses a target, it will doggedly pursue the intended victim until the break of dawn.
description_es: Persigue a su presa sin descanso allá donde vaya. No obstante, abandona la caza al amanecer.

name: Dusclops
description_en: DUSCLOPS’s body is completely hollow - there is nothing at all inside. It is said that its body is like a black hole. This POKéMON will absorb anything into its body, but nothing will ever come back out.
description_es: Si alguien mira los fuegos fatuos del interior de Dusclops, perderá su alma irremediablemente.

name: Tropius
description_en: The bunches of fruit around TROPIUS’s neck are very popular with children. This POKéMON loves fruit, and eats it continuously. Apparently, its love for fruit resulted in its own outgrowth of fruit.
description_es: Puede volar al agitar sus grandes hojas. Reparte entre los niños la codiciada fruta dulce que crece de su cuello.

name: Chimecho
description_en: CHIMECHO makes its cries echo inside its hollow body. When this POKéMON becomes enraged, its cries result in ultrasonic waves that have the power to knock foes flying.
description_es: Se cuelga de ramas y aleros con la ventosa de su cabeza. Tiene siete tipos de gritos diferentes.

name: Absol
description_en: Every time ABSOL appears before people, it is followed by a disaster such as an earthquake or a tidal wave. As a result, it came to be known as the disaster POKéMON.
description_es: Presiente desastres inminentes y se aparece a la gente para advertir del peligro.

name: Wynaut
description_en: WYNAUT can always be seen with a big, happy smile on its face. Look at its tail to determine if it is angry. When angered, this POKéMON will be slapping the ground with its tail.
description_es: Suelen ir en grupo y a la hora de dormir se resguardan en una cueva.

name: Snorunt
description_en: SNORUNT live in regions with heavy snowfall. In seasons without snow, such as spring and summer, this POKéMON steals away to live quietly among stalactites and stalagmites deep in caverns.
description_es: Se dice que se reúnen en grupos bajo hojas gigantescas y viven allí en total armonía.

name: Glalie
description_en: GLALIE has a body made of rock, which it hardens with an armor of ice. This POKéMON has the ability to freeze moisture in the atmosphere into any shape it desires.
description_es: Se protege con una armadura de hielo creada por congelación de la humedad del aire.

name: Spheal
description_en: SPHEAL is much faster rolling than walking to get around. When groups of this POKéMON eat, they all clap at once to show their pleasure. Because of this, their mealtimes are noisy.
description_es: Como no saben nadar muy bien, se mueven rápidamente rodando. Cuando están alegres, dan palmadas con las aletas.

name: Sealeo
description_en: SEALEO has the habit of always juggling on the tip of its nose anything it sees for the first time. This POKéMON occasionally entertains itself by balancing and rolling a SPHEAL on its nose.
description_es: Su nariz es muy sensible. Cuando ve algo por primera vez, lo toca con ella para recordarlo después.

name: Walrein
description_en: WALREIN’s two massively developed tusks can totally shatter blocks of ice weighing ten tons with one blow. This POKéMON’s thick coat of blubber insulates it from subzero temperatures.
description_es: Rompe el hielo con sus colmillos. Su gruesa capa de grasa le protege del frío y de los enemigos.

name: Clamperl
description_en: CLAMPERL’s sturdy shell is not only good for protection - it is also used for clamping and catching prey. A fully grown CLAMPERL’s shell will be scored with nicks and scratches all over.
description_es: Produce durante su vida una sola perla que aumenta los poderes psíquicos al evolucionar.

name: Huntail
description_en: HUNTAIL’s presence went unnoticed by people for a long time because it lives at extreme depths in the sea. This POKéMON’s eyes can see clearly even in the murky dark depths of the ocean.
description_es: Vive en los abismos marinos, donde no se filtra la luz. Tiene una cola en forma de pez, que enciende para atraer a su presa.

name: Gorebyss
description_en: GOREBYSS lives in the southern seas at extreme depths. Its body is built to withstand the enormous pressure of water at incredible depths. Because of this, this POKéMON’s body is unharmed by ordinary attacks.
description_es: Vive en el fondo del mar. En primavera, su cuerpo rosado adquiere colores más vivos.

name: Relicanth
description_en: RELICANTH is a POKéMON species that existed for a hundred million years without ever changing its form. This ancient POKéMON feeds on microscopic organisms with its toothless mouth.
description_es: No ha sufrido ningún cambio desde hace 100 millones de años. Fue descubierto durante una expedición marina.

name: Luvdisc
description_en: LUVDISC live in shallow seas in the tropics. This heart-shaped POKéMON earned its name by swimming after loving couples it spotted in the ocean’s waves.
description_es: Vive en mares cálidos. Se dice que, si una pareja lo encuentra, será bendecida con amor eterno.

name: Bagon
description_en: BAGON has a dream of one day soaring in the sky. In doomed efforts to fly, this POKéMON hurls itself off cliffs. As a result of its dives, its head has grown tough and as hard as tempered steel.
description_es: Su desarrollado cuello y su cabeza dura como el acero le permiten reducir a añicos rocas enormes.

name: Shelgon
description_en: Inside SHELGON’s armor-like shell, cells are in the midst of transformation to create an entirely new body. This POKéMON’s shell is extremely heavy, making its movements sluggish.
description_es: Las células han empezado a cambiar dentro de su dura concha, que se separa cuando evoluciona.

name: Salamence
description_en: SALAMENCE came about as a result of a strong, long-held dream of growing wings. It is said that this powerful desire triggered a sudden mutation in this POKéMON’s cells, causing it to sprout its magnificent wings.
description_es: Si se enfada, no hay forma de calmarlo; lo destruye todo lanzando arañazos y llamas.

name: Beldum
description_en: Instead of blood, a powerful magnetic force courses throughout BELDUM’s body. This POKéMON communicates with others by sending controlled pulses of magnetism.
description_es: Los pulsos magnéticos de su cuerpo repelen la gravedad, lo que le permite flotar en el aire.

name: Metang
description_en: When two BELDUM fuse together, METANG is formed. The brains of the BELDUM are joined by a magnetic nervous system. By linking its brains magnetically, this POKéMON generates strong psychokinetic power.
description_es: Lo forman dos Beldum unidos. Puede chocarse con un avión sin que su cuerpo de acero sufra ni un rasguño.

name: Metagross
description_en: METAGROSS has four brains in total. Combined, the four brains can breeze through difficult calculations faster than a supercomputer. This POKéMON can float in the air by tucking in its four legs.
description_es: Gracias a sus cuatro cerebros, es más inteligente que un superordenador y analiza con precisión al enemigo.

name: Regirock
description_en: REGIROCK was sealed away by people long ago. If this POKéMON’s body is damaged in battle, it is said to seek out suitable rocks on its own to repair itself.
description_es: Su cuerpo está hecho de roca. Si se astilla durante el combate, emplea piedras para repararlo.

name: Regice
description_en: REGICE’s body was made during an ice age. The deep-frozen body can’t be melted, even by fire. This POKéMON controls frigid air of minus 328 degrees F.
description_es: Dicen que ha yacido durmiendo en un glaciar durante milenios. Ni el magma puede derretir su cuerpo.

name: Registeel
description_en: REGISTEEL has a body that is harder than any kind of metal. Its body is apparently hollow. No one has any idea what this POKéMON eats.
description_es: Su cuerpo ha estado sometido a la presión subterránea durante miles de años y no puede arañarse.

name: Latias
description_en: LATIAS is highly sensitive to the emotions of people. If it senses any hostility, this POKéMON ruffles the feathers all over its body and cries shrilly to intimidate the foe.
description_es: Se comunica por telepatía. Su plumaje refleja la luz, lo que le permite hacerse invisible.

name: Latios
description_en: LATIOS has the ability to make its foe see an image of what it has seen or imagines in its head. This POKéMON is intelligent and understands human speech.
description_es: Es un Pokémon muy inteligente. Puede adelantar a aviones a reacción plegando las alas.

name: Kyogre
description_en: KYOGRE has the power to create massive rain clouds that cover the entire sky and bring about torrential downpours. This POKéMON saved people who were suffering from droughts.
description_es: Pokémon legendario que aumentó los mares con diluvios y maremotos. Fue un enemigo acérrimo de Groudon.

name: Groudon
description_en: GROUDON has long been described in mythology as the POKéMON that raised lands and expanded continents. This POKéMON took to sleep after a cataclysmic battle with KYOGRE.
description_es: Dicen que aumentó la superficie terrestre evaporando el agua. Fue un enemigo acérrimo de Kyogre.

name: Rayquaza
description_en: RAYQUAZA lived for hundreds of millions of years in the earth’s ozone layer, never descending to the ground. This POKéMON appears to feed on water and particles in the atmosphere.
description_es: Vive en la capa de ozono sobre las nubes y no puede ser visto desde el suelo.

name: Jirachi
description_en: A legend states that JIRACHI will make true any wish that is written on notes attached to its head when it awakens. If this POKéMON senses danger, it will fight without awakening.
description_es: Desde antaño se dice que concederá los deseos escritos en las notas de su cabeza cuando se despierte.

name: Deoxys-normal
description_en: The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in DEOXYS. The crystalline organ on this POKéMON’s chest appears to be its brain.
description_es: Surgió a raíz de la mutación de ADN de un virus alienígena que cayó a la Tierra en un meteorito.

name: Turtwig
description_en: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.
description_es: Realiza la fotosíntesis al bañarle los rayos de sol. Su concha está formada por tierra endurecida.

name: Grotle
description_en: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.
description_es: Vive en los bosques cerca del agua. Por el día, sale a que les dé el sol a las plantas de su espalda.

name: Torterra
description_en: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.
description_es: Las gentes de antaño creían que el planeta se sustentaba en la espalda de un gran Torterra.

name: Chimchar
description_en: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.
description_es: El gas de su panza alimenta el fuego de su parte trasera, que ni la lluvia puede extinguir.

name: Monferno
description_en: To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.
description_es: Controla hábilmente la intensidad del fuego de su cola para mantener al enemigo a una distancia ideal.

name: Infernape
description_en: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.
description_es: Su corona de fuego demuestra su naturaleza ígnea. Nadie le gana en velocidad.

name: Piplup
description_en: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.
description_es: No le gusta que lo cuiden. Como no aprecia el apoyo de su Entrenador, le cuesta coger confianza con él.

name: Prinplup
description_en: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.
description_es: Vive solo, alejado de los demás. Cada uno piensa que es el más importante.

name: Empoleon
description_en: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.
description_es: Nada tan rápido como un fueraborda. Con los afilados bordes de sus alas puede cortar el hielo.

name: Starly
description_en: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.
description_es: Viaja en grandes bandadas. Aunque es pequeño, agita las alas con gran fuerza.

name: Staravia
description_en: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.
description_es: Vive siempre en grandes grupos y las disputas dentro de ellos son muy intensas.

name: Staraptor
description_en: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.
description_es: Sus alas y sus patas son muy fuertes. Puede llevarse volando Pokémon pequeños.

name: Bidoof
description_en: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.
description_es: Tiene nervios de acero y nada puede perturbarlo. Es más ágil y activo de lo que aparenta.

name: Bibarel
description_en: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.
description_es: Con sus incisivos roe ramas y raíces y las apila para construir sus madrigueras junto al río.

name: Kricketot
description_en: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.
description_es: Hablan entre sí chocando las antenas. Los sonidos producidos son muy característicos.

name: Kricketune
description_en: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.
description_es: Cuando llora, cruza sus brazos con forma de cuchillo. Puede improvisar melodías.

name: Shinx
description_en: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.
description_es: La extensión y contracción de sus músculos genera electricidad. Brilla cuando está en peligro.

name: Luxio
description_en: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.
description_es: Sus garras emiten electricidad que puede debilitar a sus rivales. Viven en grupos pequeños.

name: Luxray
description_en: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.
description_es: Cuando sus ojos brillan como el oro, puede ver presas escondidas, incluso detrás de un muro.

name: Budew
description_en: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.
description_es: Vive cerca de aguas cristalinas. Su cabello se abre y esparce polen cuando le bañan los rayos del sol.

name: Roserade
description_en: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.
description_es: Atrae a sus presas con una dulce fragancia y usa sus cepas venenosas para atenazarlas y acabar con ellas.

name: Cranidos
description_en: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.
description_es: Fue recreado a partir de un fósil con forma esférica. Derriba a las presas a cabezazos.

name: Rampardos
description_en: Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.
description_es: Tiene sesos pequeños porque su duro cráneo, que soporta cualquier golpe, les impide desarrollarse.

name: Shieldon
description_en: A Pokémon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.
description_es: Se abrillanta la cara frotándola contra los árboles. Es vulnerable a los ataques por la espalda.

name: Bastiodon
description_en: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.
description_es: Se alineaban y creaban una barrera que ningún enemigo podía cruzar. Así protegían a sus crías.

name: Burmy
description_en: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.
description_es: Para protegerse de los vientos fríos invernales, se cubre con un caparazón de ramas y hojas.

name: Wormadam-plant
description_en: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.
description_es: Su apariencia varía según dónde evolucione. Los materiales que haya pasan a formar parte de su cuerpo.

name: Mothim
description_en: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by COMBEE.
description_es: Le encanta la miel de las flores y roba la que recoge Combee.

name: Combee
description_en: A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to VESPIQUEN.
description_es: El trío se forma al nacer y se pasa la vida recogiendo miel de las flores para satisfacer a Vespiquen.

name: Vespiquen
description_en: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by COMBEE.
description_es: Cría larvas en los panales de su cuerpo. Segrega diversas feromonas de su cuerpo con las cuales controla a sus crías.

name: Pachirisu
description_en: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.
description_es: Crea bolas de pelo que crepitan con electricidad estática. Las almacena en agujeros de árboles.

name: Buizel
description_en: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.
description_es: Nada rotando sus dos colas a modo de tornillo. Cuando bucea, el flotador se pliega.

name: Floatzel
description_en: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.
description_es: Nada gracias a su flotador. Ayuda en los rescates de gente que se está ahogando.

name: Cherubi
description_en: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.
description_es: Bajo la luz solar es rojo. La esfera pequeña pierde sus nutrientes y se seca para anunciar la evolución.

name: Cherrim
description_en: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.
description_es: Cuando los rayos de sol inundan su capullo, abre de par en par sus pétalos y se vuelve muy dinámico.

name: Shellos
description_en: Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.
description_es: No hay que apretarle muy fuerte, ya que, si lo haces, secreta un misterioso fluido morado.

name: Gastrodon
description_en: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.
description_es: Si se ve amenazado por sus enemigos naturales, segrega un líquido morado y huye rápidamente.

name: Ambipom
description_en: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.
description_es: Habitan en grandes colonias y forman anillos uniendo sus colas, aparentemente en signo de amistad.

name: Drifloon
description_en: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.
description_es: Está formado por los espíritus de personas y Pokémon. Le encantan las estaciones húmedas.

name: Drifblim
description_en: It’s drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.
description_es: Transporta a gente y a Pokémon volando, pero, como se deja llevar, puede acabar en cualquier sitio.

name: Buneary
description_en: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.
description_es: Lleva las orejas enrolladas. Cuando las extiende, golpea con tal fuerza que incluso puede romper rocas.

name: Lopunny
description_en: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.
description_es: Este Pokémon resulta muy precavido. Si siente peligro, escapa corriendo a grandes saltos.

name: Mismagius
description_en: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.
description_es: Recita cánticos. Algunos de ellos atormentan a sus rivales, mientras que otros producen felicidad.

name: Honchkrow
description_en: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous MURKROW in tow.
description_es: Si uno lanza un grito profundo, los demás acuden. Por eso se le llama también Invocador de la Noche.

name: Glameow
description_en: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.
description_es: Araña cuando está enfadado y ronronea cuando está cariñoso. Su imprevisibilidad es famosa.

name: Purugly
description_en: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon’s nest and claims it as its own.
description_es: Si se siente a gusto, no tiene ningún reparo en apropiarse de las moradas de otros Pokémon.

name: Chingling
description_en: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.
description_es: Emite un tintineo cada vez que salta. Ensordece a sus rivales con sonidos de alta frecuencia.

name: Stunky
description_en: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.
description_es: Expulsa un fluido maloliente por sus cuartos traseros. El hedor repele Pokémon en un radio de 2 km.

name: Skuntank
description_en: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.
description_es: Para atacar, emite un fluido maloliente por la punta de su cola que puede llegar a más de 50 m.

name: Bronzor
description_en: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.
description_es: Antaño se creía que en los dibujos de su parte posterior residía una fuerza misteriosa.

name: Bronzong
description_en: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.
description_es: Desde antaño se adora a este Pokémon para que propicie lluvias abundantes. A veces se esconde bajo tierra.

name: Bonsly
description_en: It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body’s fluid levels by eliminating excess.
description_es: Prefiere entornos áridos. Sus ojos expulsan agua para ajustar los niveles de fluido corporal.

name: Mime-jr
description_en: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.
description_es: Desconcierta a sus rivales imitando sus movimientos a la perfección y aprovecha para darse a la fuga.

name: Happiny
description_en: It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.
description_es: Les da a sus amigos una roca con forma de huevo que transporta en la bolsa de su panza.

name: Chatot
description_en: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.
description_es: Imita los sonidos de sus rivales, haciéndoles creer que son amigos e impidiendo que le ataquen.

name: Spiritomb
description_en: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.
description_es: Se formó a partir de 108 espíritus. Está unido a la fisura de una piedra angular mística.

name: Gible
description_en: It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.
description_es: Vive en agujeros en las cuevas, al amparo del calor geotérmico. Si se acerca un enemigo, le muerde.

name: Gabite
description_en: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scales will heal even incurable illnesses.
description_es: Le gustan las cosas brillantes. Busca tesoros en cuevas y se lleva el botín a su nido.

name: Garchomp
description_en: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.
description_es: Cuando despliega su cuerpo y sus alas, parece un avión a reacción. Vuela a velocidad sónica.

name: Munchlax
description_en: It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.
description_es: Esconde comida bajo el largo pelo de su cuerpo, pero más tarde lo olvida.

name: Riolu
description_en: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.
description_es: Se comunica con los suyos mediante la emisión de unas ondas que cambian de forma en función de los sentimientos.

name: Lucario
description_en: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.
description_es: Puede leer los pensamientos y movimientos de su adversario a través de su aura.

name: Hippopotas
description_en: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.
description_es: Vive en zonas áridas. En lugar de sudar, su cuerpo expulsa granos de arena.

name: Hippowdon
description_en: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.
description_es: Hace gala de su fuerza abriendo su enorme boca. Para atacar levanta gran cantidad de arena.

name: Skorupi
description_en: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.
description_es: Agarra a sus presas con las pinzas de la cola y les inyecta veneno. Espera hasta que hace efecto.

name: Drapion
description_en: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.
description_es: Aunque sabe que puede aplastar al rival con su gran fuerza, le gusta dar el golpe de gracia con su virulento veneno.

name: Croagunk
description_en: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.
description_es: Tiene bolsas venenosas en las mejillas. Pilla desprevenidos a sus rivales para pincharles.

name: Toxicroak
description_en: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.
description_es: Almacena veneno en una bolsa de la garganta. Cuando croa, este se agita para lograr mayor potencia.

name: Carnivine
description_en: It attracts prey with its sweet- smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.
description_es: Atrae a sus presas con saliva de olor dulce y las mastica. Tarda todo un día en comérselas.

name: Finneon
description_en: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.
description_es: La línea que le recorre el costado puede almacenar luz solar. Brilla con mucha fuerza por la noche.

name: Lumineon
description_en: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.
description_es: Vive en las profundidades marinas. Atrae a sus presas con parpadeos del dibujo de sus cuatro aletas.

name: Mantyke
description_en: A friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.
description_es: Los símbolos de su espalda cambian según la región. A veces se mezcla con bancos de Remoraid y nada junto a ellos.

name: Snover
description_en: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.
description_es: En las estaciones frías baja al pie de la montaña, pero regresa a las cimas nevadas en primavera.

name: Abomasnow
description_en: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.
description_es: Genera ventiscas con las que cubre de nieve grandes áreas. Se le llama el Monstruo de Hielo.

name: Weavile
description_en: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.
description_es: Vive en zonas nevadas. Deja marcas en los árboles con sus garras para comunicarse con sus compañeros.

name: Magnezone
description_en: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.
description_es: Emiten campos magnéticos tan potentes que se atraen entre sí e incluso pueden llegar a inmovilizarse.

name: Lickilicky
description_en: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.
description_es: Agarra cosas con su lengua extensible. Si te acercas mucho, te deja lleno de babas.

name: Rhyperior
description_en: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. GEODUDE are shot at rare times.
description_es: Lanza Geodude por los agujeros de las manos. Gracias a Protector resiste erupciones volcánicas.

name: Tangrowth
description_en: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.
description_es: Atrapa a su presa desplegando las ramas de sus brazos, que no le importa perder ante depredadores.

name: Electivire
description_en: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.
description_es: Al almacenar mucha electricidad, desprende chispas de una claridad increíble entre sus dos cuernos.

name: Magmortar
description_en: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.
description_es: Sus brazos disparan bolas de fuego de más de 2000 °C. Vive en cráteres volcánicos.

name: Togekiss
description_en: It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently.
description_es: Se dice que aparece en zonas pacíficas y las bendice con sus dones.

name: Yanmega
description_en: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.
description_es: Su técnica favorita consiste en volar a gran velocidad y despedazar con su mandíbula a su oponente en un instante.

name: Leafeon
description_en: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.
description_es: En días soleados duerme y hace la fotosíntesis, emitiendo aire puro a su alrededor.

name: Glaceon
description_en: As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles.
description_es: Controla su temperatura corporal para congelar el ambiente y causar ráfagas de nieve en polvo.

name: Gliscor
description_en: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!
description_es: Espera a sus presas colgado de una rama bocabajo. Cuando llega su oportunidad, se lanza en picado.

name: Mamoswine
description_en: Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.
description_es: Ya existía en la antigüedad. Se encontró uno bajo hielo de hace más de 10 000 años.

name: Porygon-z
description_en: Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.
description_es: Se le instaló un software para mejorarlo. Sin embargo, comenzó a comportarse de manera extraña.

name: Gallade
description_en: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.
description_es: Puede presentir los movimientos de sus rivales y por eso ataca siempre antes que ellos.

name: Probopass
description_en: It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.
description_es: Emana un fuerte magnetismo. Controla tres pequeñas unidades llamadas mininarices.

name: Dusknoir
description_en: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.
description_es: Se dice que recoge en su cuerpo flexible a los espíritus extraviados y los guía hasta casa.

name: Froslass
description_en: It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees F. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.
description_es: Congela a sus enemigos con un aliento gélido de -50 °C. Su cuerpo está hueco.

name: Rotom
description_en: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.
description_es: Desde hace mucho tiempo se estudia su singular motor como fuente de energía motriz.

name: Uxie
description_en: Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.
description_es: Se le conoce como el Ser de la Sabiduría. Se dice que puede borrar la memoria con una mirada.

name: Mesprit
description_en: Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.
description_es: Se le conoce como el Ser de la Emoción. Enseñó a los humanos la nobleza del dolor y la alegría.

name: Azelf
description_en: Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.
description_es: Se le conoce como el Ser de la Voluntad. Duerme en el fondo de un lago para equilibrar el mundo.

name: Dialga
description_en: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.
description_es: Un Pokémon de leyenda. Se dice que el tiempo comenzó a avanzar cuando Dialga nació.

name: Palkia
description_en: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.
description_es: Se dice que vive en una dimensión espacial paralela. Aparece en la mitología.

name: Heatran
description_en: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.
description_es: Habita cuevas volcánicas. Cava con sus pies en forma de cruz para trepar por techos y paredes.

name: Regigigas
description_en: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.
description_es: Se dice que usó rocas, magma y un hielo especial de montaña para crear Pokémon con su aspecto.

name: Giratina-altered
description_en: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.
description_es: Vive en el Mundo Distorsión, un mundo opuesto al nuestro y cuyas leyes desafían el sentido común.

name: Cresselia
description_en: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
description_es: Sus alas emiten un velo de partículas brillantes. Se dice que representa un cuarto lunar.

name: Phione
description_en: A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.
description_es: Si sube la temperatura del mar, infla el flotador de su cabeza y flota en grupo en la superficie.

name: Manaphy
description_en: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.
description_es: Nace con un maravilloso poder que le permite establecer vínculos con cualquier tipo de Pokémon.

name: Darkrai
description_en: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.
description_es: Defiende su territorio de personas y Pokémon haciéndoles dormir y provocándoles pesadillas.

name: Shaymin-land
description_en: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.
description_es: Puede disolver las toxinas del aire para transformar tierra yerma en campos de flores.

name: Arceus
description_en: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.
description_es: Según la mitología de Sinnoh, Arceus surgió de un huevo y después creó todo el mundo.

name: Victini
description_en: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.
description_es: Pokémon que atrae la victoria. Dicen que el Entrenador que lo lleve saldrá vencedor de cualquier batalla.

name: Snivy
description_en: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.
description_es: Cuando recibe los rayos de sol, se mueve mucho más rápido que de costumbre. Usa mejor sus lianas que sus manos.

name: Servine
description_en: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.
description_es: Parece que se desliza al correr. Engaña a sus rivales con su velocidad y los fustiga con su látigo.

name: Serperior
description_en: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.
description_es: Tan solo muestra su verdadero poder a quienes no se amedrentan ante su noble pero inquisitoria mirada.

name: Tepig
description_en: It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.
description_es: Evita con agilidad los ataques enemigos. Lanza bolas de fuego por su hocico y tuesta bayas del bosque para comer.

name: Pignite
description_en: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.
description_es: Cuanto más come, más combustible tiene en su interior para avivar sus llamas, con lo que también aumenta su poder.

name: Emboar
description_en: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.
description_es: Calienta sus puños con las llamas de su barbilla para propinar puñetazos ardientes. Es muy fiel a sus compañeros.

name: Oshawott
description_en: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.
description_es: La vieira de su ombligo no solo sirve como arma, sino también como instrumento para cortar las bayas que estén duras.

name: Dewott
description_en: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.
description_es: Gran espadachín. Utiliza sus dos vieiras con soltura al ejecutar las técnicas que aprende con una disciplina espartana.

name: Samurott
description_en: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.
description_es: En un abrir y cerrar de ojos, puede desenvainar y envainar los sables que hay en sus patas delanteras.

name: Patrat
description_en: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.
description_es: Almacena víveres en unas bolsas en sus mofletes y vigila durante días. Hace señales con la cola a sus compañeros.

name: Watchog
description_en: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.
description_es: Los componentes luminiscentes de su interior hacen que sus ojos y su cuerpo brillen, y así intimida a sus rivales.

name: Lillipup
description_en: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.
description_es: Los mechones que cubren su cara actúan como un magnífico radar para detectar con precisión lo que hay a su alrededor.

name: Herdier
description_en: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.
description_es: Este Pokémon es muy leal. No solo ayuda a Entrenadores, sino que también se preocupa por otros Pokémon.

name: Stoutland
description_en: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.
description_es: Socorre a humanos perdidos en montañas azotadas por ventiscas. Su largo pelaje le protege del frío.

name: Purrloin
description_en: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can’t help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.
description_es: Distrae a su oponente con movimientos gráciles y sustrae sus pertenencias. Cuando se enfada, ataca con las garras.

name: Liepard
description_en: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.
description_es: Su bella y grácil silueta le viene dada por su desarrollada musculatura, que le permite andar de noche sin hacer ruido.

name: Pansage
description_en: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.
description_es: Comparte las hojas de su cabeza con Pokémon agotados. Posee la facultad de aliviar el cansancio.

name: Simisage
description_en: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.
description_es: Ataca estampando las espinas de su cola en el enemigo. Es un Pokémon con mucho temperamento.

name: Pansear
description_en: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.
description_es: Pokémon muy inteligente que tiene la costumbre de tostar las bayas antes de comérselas. Ayuda mucho a los humanos.

name: Simisear
description_en: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.
description_es: Achicharra a sus enemigos desprendiendo llamas por la cola y la cabeza, fruto de su desmesurado calor interno.

name: Panpour
description_en: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.
description_es: El agua acumulada en su mata de pelo es rica en nutrientes. Usa su cola para regar plantas con esa misma agua.

name: Simipour
description_en: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.
description_es: Cuando lanza agua a alta presión con su cola, puede incluso resquebrajar una pared de cemento.

name: Munna
description_en: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.
description_es: Cuando un humano o un Pokémon sufre una pesadilla, Munna se aparece ante ellos y la engulle.

name: Musharna
description_en: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.
description_es: Multitud de sueños de humanos y Pokémon se encuentran atrapados en el humo que despide por su frente.

name: Pidove
description_en: Each follows its Trainer’s orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.
description_es: Es un Pokémon muy despistado. Aunque reciba órdenes de su Entrenador, se le olvidan, y se queda esperando.

name: Tranquill
description_en: It can return to its Trainer’s location regardless of the distance separating them.
description_es: Según los rumores, en lo más profundo del bosque donde mora Tranquill, hay un mundo pacífico y exento de luchas.

name: Unfezant
description_en: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females’ flying abilities surpass those of the males.
description_es: El macho amenaza al enemigo meciendo el adorno de su cabeza. Al volar, la hembra es mucho más diestra que el macho.

name: Blitzle
description_en: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.
description_es: Aparece cuando nubes envueltas en rayos encapotan el cielo. Atrapa rayos con su crin y almacena electricidad.

name: Zebstrika
description_en: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.
description_es: Es un Pokémon con mucho temperamento. Cuando se enoja, lanza rayos desde su crin en todas direcciones.

name: Roggenrola
description_en: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.
description_es: Su oreja tiene forma hexagonal. Su cuerpo fue comprimido bajo tierra. Por eso, es duro como el acero.

name: Boldore
description_en: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.
description_es: La energía que no puede contener en el interior de su cuerpo se escapa formando cristales naranjas.

name: Gigalith
description_en: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.
description_es: Absorbe los rayos solares, procesa esa energía en su núcleo y lanza poderosas bolas de luz a sus enemigos.

name: Woobat
description_en: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.
description_es: Vive en bosques oscuros y cavernas. Emite ultrasonidos por la nariz para saber todo lo que pasa a su alrededor.

name: Swoobat
description_en: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.
description_es: Cuando emite ondas ultrasónicas, que incluso pueden reventar el cemento, agita su cola con vehemencia.

name: Drilbur
description_en: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.
description_es: Cuando junta las garras y comienza a dar vueltas frenéticas, avanza bajo tierra a gran velocidad.

name: Excadrill
description_en: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.
description_es: Su taladro ha evolucionado y es capaz de atravesar una lámina de hierro. Es muy útil para construir túneles.

name: Audino
description_en: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.
description_es: Con las antenas de sus oídos, perciben el estado de un rival o predicen cuándo va a eclosionar un Huevo Pokémon.

name: Timburr
description_en: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.
description_es: Siempre lleva vigas de madera. Normalmente ayuda en obras de construcción.

name: Gurdurr
description_en: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.
description_es: Gracias a su entrenada musculatura, puede blandir vigas de acero sin problema para así derribar edificios enteros.

name: Conkeldurr
description_en: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.
description_es: Se cree que Conkeldurr enseñó a los humanos la técnica para elaborar cemento hace más de 2000 años.

name: Tympole
description_en: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.
description_es: Emite sonidos imperceptibles para los humanos con la vibración de sus mejillas y advierte de algún peligro a los suyos.

name: Palpitoad
description_en: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.
description_es: Cuando hace vibrar el bulto de su cabeza, no solo se embravece el mar, sino que la tierra también tiembla.

name: Seismitoad
description_en: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.
description_es: Aumenta la potencia de sus puñetazos haciendo vibrar sus puños. Es capaz de quebrar una roca de un solo golpe.

name: Throh
description_en: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.
description_es: Aumenta su potencia si se aprieta el cinturón. Un Throh salvaje teje su propio cinturón usando lianas.

name: Sawk
description_en: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.
description_es: Para lograr dominar las técnicas de kárate más letales, se retiran a las montañas y entrenan día y noche.

name: Sewaddle
description_en: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.
description_es: Recorta hojas y las teje con el líquido viscoso que segrega por la boca para hacerse su propia ropa.

name: Swadloon
description_en: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.
description_es: La vegetación abunda en los bosques que habita. Este Pokémon transforma las hojas caídas en nutrientes.

name: Leavanny
description_en: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.
description_es: Si se encuentra con un Pokémon joven, segrega por la boca hilos pegadizos con los que le teje una prenda de ropa.

name: Venipede
description_en: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.
description_es: Percibe su entorno con su sentido del tacto, residente en su cabeza y cola. Su carácter es violento por naturaleza.

name: Whirlipede
description_en: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.
description_es: Lo protege un duro caparazón. Gira como una rueda y realiza brutales placajes contra sus enemigos.

name: Scolipede
description_en: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.
description_es: Atenaza a sus presas con las garras que sobresalen de su cuello hasta que no se pueden mover y las remata con veneno.

name: Cottonee
description_en: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.
description_es: Despide motas de algodón cuando lo atacan para confundir a los enemigos y poner pies en polvorosa.

name: Whimsicott
description_en: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.
description_es: Aparecen en medio de un torbellino y entran en las casas para descolocar los muebles o esparcir algodón por doquier.

name: Petilil
description_en: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.
description_es: Mordisquear las hojas de su cabeza permite recuperar toda la vitalidad, a pesar de que están muy amargas.

name: Lilligant
description_en: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.
description_es: El aroma de la flor de su tocado relaja a cualquiera a su alrededor. Hay que cuidarle mucho para que no se marchite.

name: Basculin-red-striped
description_en: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they’ll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.
description_es: Los de color azul y los de color rojo siempre se pelean. Son muy violentos, pero su sabor es excepcional.

name: Sandile
description_en: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.
description_es: Se desplaza hundido en la arena, dejando al descubierto solo los ojos y la nariz. Una membrana negra le protege los ojos.

name: Krokorok
description_en: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.
description_es: Viven en manadas. La membrana que cubre sus ojos los protege de la arena.

name: Krookodile
description_en: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.
description_es: Un Pokémon bastante violento. Ataca todo lo que se mueva delante de él con sus mortíferas mandíbulas.

name: Darumaka
description_en: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.
description_es: Como sus excrementos están muy calientes, la gente de antaño se los metía en los bolsillos para calentarse.

name: Darmanitan-standard
description_en: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.
description_es: Cuando resulta gravemente herido, se endurece como una piedra y medita para agudizar la mente.

name: Maractus
description_en: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.
description_es: Espanta a los Pokémon pájaro con un baile rápido y haciendo ruido para evitar que picoteen las semillas de sus flores.

name: Dwebble
description_en: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.
description_es: Abre un agujero en la roca y vive en él. Si la roca se resquebraja, no se queda tranquilo hasta que no encuentra otra.

name: Crustle
description_en: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.
description_es: Su inmensa capacidad motriz le permite desplazarse cargando a sus espaldas rocas enormes durante días.

name: Scraggy
description_en: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.
description_es: Se sube la piel hasta el cuello para defenderse. Su elasticidad, similar a la de una goma, reduce el daño recibido.

name: Scrafty
description_en: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.
description_es: Se protege de los ataques con la muda de su piel mientras reparte patadas. Cuanto mayor es su cresta, más se le respeta.

name: Sigilyph
description_en: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.
description_es: Fue la deidad protectora de una ciudad milenaria. Ataca con su poder psíquico a los enemigos que invaden su territorio.

name: Yamask
description_en: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.
description_es: Almas de humanos sepultados en tumbas que han adquirido forma de Pokémon. Recuerdan su vida antes de la muerte.

name: Cofagrigus
description_en: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.
description_es: Se comenta que engulle a todo humano que se le acerca y lo momifica. Su comida favorita son las pepitas de oro.

name: Tirtouga
description_en: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.
description_es: Ya pululaba por las aguas hace 100 millones de años. También va a tierra a veces en busca de alimento.

name: Carracosta
description_en: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.
description_es: Vive en el mar y en la superficie. Sus garras pueden abrir un agujero en el fondo de un petrolero.

name: Archen
description_en: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.
description_es: Pokémon que renació de un fósil. Dicen que es el antepasado de todos los Pokémon pájaro.

name: Archeops
description_en: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.
description_es: Levanta el vuelo tras coger carrerilla. Coopera con sus compañeros de bandada para atrapar a sus presas.

name: Trubbish
description_en: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.
description_es: Pokémon nacido de la reacción química entre una bolsa de basura y residuos industriales.

name: Garbodor
description_en: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.
description_es: Apresa a su rival con el brazo izquierdo y le da el golpe de gracia exhalando por la boca un apestoso gas venenoso.

name: Zorua
description_en: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.
description_es: Adopta la apariencia de su enemigo para engañarlo vilmente y aprovecha su estupor para poner tierra por medio.

name: Zoroark
description_en: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.
description_es: Tiene la facultad de confundir a muchos humanos a la vez. Protege su guarida creando un paisaje ilusorio.

name: Minccino
description_en: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.
description_es: Se saludan entre sí frotándose con la cola y limpiándose a conciencia.

name: Cinccino
description_en: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.
description_es: El pelo que cubre su cuerpo proporciona una agradable sensación al tocarlo. No acumula ni polvo ni electricidad estática.

name: Gothita
description_en: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.
description_es: Amplifica su poder psíquico con sus antenitas en forma de lazo. Siempre está mirando algo fijamente.

name: Gothorita
description_en: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.
description_es: La luz de las estrellas origina su poder. De noche, marca su posición haciendo levitar piedras con su poder psíquico.

name: Gothitelle
description_en: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.
description_es: Su inmenso poder psíquico distorsiona el espacio y le permite reflejar incluso estrellas a años luz de distancia.

name: Solosis
description_en: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.
description_es: Gracias a la sustancia viscosa que envuelve su cuerpo, permanece tranquilo por dura o rigurosa que sea la situación.

name: Duosion
description_en: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.
description_es: Dado que su cerebro está dividido en dos, a veces tiene conflictos a la hora de decidir qué hacer.

name: Reuniclus
description_en: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.
description_es: Hacen gala de su poder psíquico y mueven sus brazos compuestos de líquido para controlar rocas y hacerlas añicos.

name: Ducklett
description_en: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food--peat moss.
description_es: Cuando se ve atacado, las plumas que lo recubren despiden ráfagas de agua que lo ayudan a escapar.

name: Swanna
description_en: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.
description_es: Aunque no lo parezca por su grácil elegancia, puede batir con fuerza las alas y volar durante miles de kilómetros.

name: Vanillite
description_en: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.
description_es: Lanza un aliento de -50 °C. Crea bloques de nieve y es capaz de lograr que nieve a su alrededor.

name: Vanillish
description_en: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon’s habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.
description_es: Enfrían el aire a su alrededor y crean partículas de hielo mediante las cuales congelan a sus oponentes.

name: Vanilluxe
description_en: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.
description_es: Si sus dos cabezas se irritan al mismo tiempo, genera una ventisca desde su cuerno cubriendo su entorno con nieve.

name: Deerling
description_en: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.
description_es: El color de su cuerpo cambia no solo con las estaciones, sino también con los cambios de humedad y temperatura.

name: Sawsbuck
description_en: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.
description_es: Cambia de morada dependiendo de las estaciones. Observando sus cuernos, la gente sabe cuándo estas van a cambiar.

name: Emolga
description_en: The energy made in its cheeks’ electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.
description_es: Vive en la copa de los árboles. Produce descargas mientras vuela con el interior de la membrana que hace de capa.

name: Karrablast
description_en: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.
description_es: Si recibe un estímulo eléctrico al estar en contacto con un Shelmet, evoluciona.

name: Escavalier
description_en: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.
description_es: Se defienden de los ataques con el caparazón que roban a los Shelmet. Atacan con sus dos mortíferas lanzas.

name: Foongus
description_en: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.
description_es: Gracias a su misterioso parecido a una Poké Ball, atrae a sus presas y lanza rápidamente esporas de veneno.

name: Amoonguss
description_en: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.
description_es: Aunque intenta pasar por parte superior de una Poké Ball para atraer a sus presas, consigue engañar a pocos.

name: Frillish-male
description_en: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.
description_es: Paraliza a sus presas con veneno y las lleva a su morada, que se encuentra a 8000 m en el fondo del mar.

name: Jellicent-male
description_en: The fate of the ships and crew that wander into Jellicent’s habitat: all sunken, all lost, all vanished.
description_es: Su cuerpo se compone de agua salada. Dicen que ha construido un palacio en el fondo del mar con restos de barcos.

name: Alomomola
description_en: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.
description_es: Vive flotando a la deriva en mar abierto. Siempre que encuentra un Pokémon herido, lo abraza y lo lleva a la costa.

name: Joltik
description_en: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.
description_es: No puede generar electricidad por sí mismo, así que se encarama a Pokémon grandes y absorbe su energía estática.

name: Galvantula
description_en: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.
description_es: Pone trampas con hilos electrificados. De este modo, electrocuta a sus enemigos y los inmoviliza por completo.

name: Ferroseed
description_en: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.
description_es: Lanza numerosas púas al detectar peligro. En cuanto tiene ocasión, echa a rodar y se escapa.

name: Ferrothorn
description_en: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.
description_es: Azota al enemigo con sus tres tentáculos y después dispara púas hasta que no deja ni rastro del rival.

name: Klink
description_en: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.
description_es: Genera la energía vital que necesita haciendo girar sus dos cuerpos.

name: Klang
description_en: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.
description_es: Muestra sus sentimientos cambiando la dirección de su giro. Cuanto más se enfade, más rápido girará.

name: Klinklang
description_en: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.
description_es: Recarga su energía rápidamente haciendo girar con gran celeridad el engranaje equipado con un núcleo rojo.

name: Tynamo
description_en: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.
description_es: La electricidad de uno solo es diminuta, pero, si multitud de Tynamo se conectan, consiguen la potencia de un rayo.

name: Eelektrik
description_en: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.
description_es: Se enrolla alrededor de su presa, la paraliza con la electricidad de sus marcas circulares y le asesta mordiscos.

name: Eelektross
description_en: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.
description_es: Pega la ventosa de su boca en su presa y la electrocuta con sus colmillos.

name: Elgyem
description_en: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent’s brain, causing unendurable headaches.
description_es: Posee un gran poder psíquico. Lo usa para comprimir el cerebro del enemigo y ocasionarle dolores de cabeza.

name: Beheeyem
description_en: It can manipulate an opponent’s memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three different-colored fingers.
description_es: Parece que se comunica haciendo brillar sus dedos tricolores, pero nadie ha conseguido descifrar aún su patrón.

name: Litwick
description_en: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.
description_es: Finge ser una luz guía en el camino, pero en realidad solo quiere absorber la energía vital de quien lo sigue.

name: Lampent
description_en: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.
description_es: Al absorber almas, su llama se enciende. Espera a que la gente fallezca, así que suele deambular por los hospitales.

name: Chandelure
description_en: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.
description_es: Sus llamas absorben el alma del enemigo y la abrasan, dejando solo su cuerpo inerte.

name: Axew
description_en: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.
description_es: Usa sus colmillos para romper las bayas que come. Estos se regeneran una y otra vez, por eso son tan fuertes y afilados.

name: Fraxure
description_en: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they’ve been fighting.
